tei:div.tei:p: dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mngon par rtogs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bzhed gzhung zhes bya ba bzhugs so hai/ /

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mngon par rtogs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bzhed gzhung zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khyab bdag mthon ka chen po'i sa 'dzin dbang*/ /dbang phyug bdud kyi dbang chen gzhi la g.yo med rol/ /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya'i bang rim lham me ba/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bla ma mchog gis dge legs mdzod/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dge legs kyi| khur chen gyis kyang mi ngal bar/ /da dung lhag bsam gru chen gyis/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /dus kyi 'khor lo dgyes pa skyed pa'i thabs| |rim pa dang po'i lam gyi pad mo'i mtsho/ /mkhas mchog ngang pa'i rgyal po du ma yis/ /ring mo zhig nas legs par nyul mod kyi/ /phyi ma'i dus 'dir bla mas legs bskyangs pas/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum lta ba'i mig dag cing*// legs bshad dril chen sgrog mkhas pad mtsho'i rgyan/ /ded dpon gzhon nu bdag kyang cis mi spro/ /bar chad kun sel dge legs kun sgrub pa'i/ /bdun lhag sum cu'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ /sde drug srung mas mthu na rkyen kun 'grub cing*/ /ma lus 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang pos dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du legs par bka' stsal pa de nyid/ dpal ldan kā la pa'i grong gi lho phyogs ma la ya'i skye sa mos tshal gyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku mi'i dbang po grags pas drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa'i skal bzang kyi skye bo mtha' yas pa la dbang bskur te rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam byin nas bsdus pa'i don rnams/ de'i sras po rje btsun pad+ma dkar pos legs par bkral ba ji lta ba bzhin du brjod par bya ba las/

rgya bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma phal cher gyis rang gi 'dod pas sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dang de'i dgos pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bzhed pa las gzhan du gyur pa byas mod kyi de dag gi dgag sgrub dang lung rigs kyi shes byed dang*/ phyag len gyi go rim/ phyag rgya'i lag 'khrid la sogs pa ni rgyas par gzhan du 'chad la/ 'dir ni cho ga'i ngag 'don gyi rin po che'i phreng ba dri ma med pa rnams tshig gi srad bu la brgyus te brjod par bya'o/ / de yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rten gyi drung du/ yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang*| bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'am byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod rdor dril cang te'u la sogs pa bshams la bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ thog mar/ rang nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas sna tshogs yum ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyu da par gyur/ de nas nang mchod la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil bstan nas/ oṃ/ zhes brjod/ g.yas pa'i mthil bstan nas/ āḥ gnyis ka'i mthi la bstan nas/ huṃ/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan nas/ ho/ de nas g.yon pa'i ma theb srin gyis lan gsum dkrug cing*/ oṃ ā:hūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod| de nas g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te mdun gyi bar snang la g.yon pa'i ma theb srin kha gyen du bstan pas nang mchod 'thor ba'i tshul byas la/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ hrī phaṭa ces rjod cing lce thog tu bzhag pas kha dag par byas la/ de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kohaṃ/ mchod rdzas rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las grub pa'i shel gyi snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ aṃ baṃ proṃ aṃ rnams las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs sil bsang gtor zhal sil rnams dang*/

dang las dri chab ma dang phreng ba ma nag mo dṛ'i dung chos dang me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/dang las bdugaspos ma dang mar me ma dmar mo spos kyi snod dang mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ dang las zhal zas ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod dang 'bras bu ma nyams pa 'dzin pa/ dang las sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo dbu rgyun dang do shal 'dzin pa/ dang las rol sgra ma dang gar ma ljang khu rnga pa ṭa ha dang gos 'dzin pa/ dang las glu ma dang 'dod ma sngon mo rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang bde ba chen po/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so dang mchod pa'i lha mo/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pū d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pro k+ṣa ṇa ཾ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā ñtsa mā naṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā / oṃ badz+ra mā le mā la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa / artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bra dī pe bra dī pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta nai wi d+ya pū dzi ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa taṃ pha la a ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya/ was+t+ra a bha ra ṇa pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya gha ṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra wā d+ya wā d+ya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gī t+ye gī t+ya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kā me sarba bud dha bo dhi sa twā nī kro dha ā dī naṃ badz+ra su ra te pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ ces pas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ de nas sgrub

mchod lta bu'i sgrub grogs dang bcas pa yin na/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang gsol gdab mchod phreng nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ skyabs 'gro spyi da nga mthu na par byas nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs yi dam la/ /byang chub bar du gus pas bdag skyabs mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi/ /rang gi spyi bor oṃ las pad+ma dang ā las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du aṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon gsum dril bu tho da pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la/ ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i sogs yab dang mtshungs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis gnyis su med par 'khyud pa/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ khyad par du yum gyi lte bar ho/ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad| sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dha tu bi shodha ni swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bkur/ lus dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/

yum la rdor sems kyis dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe mā le dhū pe pra dī pe nai wi d+ya ak+ṣa taṃ lā s+ya hā wā d+ya nṛ t+ya gī t+ye kā me artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de gnyis kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sā ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha| sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī ya ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wa na sarba ta thā ga ta badzṛ ā me muñdza badz+rir bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces tshar bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas/ bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung*| khyad par du dam tshig gi nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med par gyur| de nas mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa la bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du huṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkha'i mthil du spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying ga'i zla ba rdo rje la thim/

tshangs pa khyab 'jug drag po dag kyang gang gi zhabs kyi chu skyes drung du lhag par skyabs 'gro ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo rgyal ba mchog skyed yon tan med cing rnam rtog med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes sogs bcu gnyis brjod/ mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'bul bar bgyi/ sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags par bgyi/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang bsags pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pa rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /yon gnas mchog la bdag nyid gus 'bul phyin drug la sogs lam rnams tshogs gsum don du sgrub par bgyi/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /sgom pa bsgoms pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko ྅ haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra/ sā bha wa āt+ma ko ྅ haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko ྅haṃ| oṃ a na bhi saṃ skā ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko ྅ haṃ/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa rnam thar sgo bzhi'i rang bzhin rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su gyur/ de nas thog mar srung 'khor gyi sngon du bdag bsrung ba la dang por sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa: pradz+nya pā yo āt+ma kaṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa ti ma mā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+raṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru skan dha dhā twā ya na naṃ ni swa bha waṃ swā hā/

rang gi gtsug tor du waṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa des gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar gyi lus sbrul shun pa brjes pa bzhin du lan gsum dor ste lus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar dkar bar gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud dho ྅haṃ/ de nas rigs drug dgod pa ni| rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po las 'od dpag med dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pad dkar 'dab brgya me long bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las/ rin 'byung dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum me mda' rdo rje'i lcags kyu sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gsum gzhu dang rdo rje'i zhags pa rin chen chad gu 'dzin pa/ snying khar hūm̐ nag po las don grub nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum phub dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ lte bar ho ser po las rnam snang ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum 'khor lo dbyug pa 'jigs byed rdo rje| g.yon gsum dung dang rdo rje'i lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa| gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ gsang bar k+ṣa sngon po las rdor sems sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta| g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas sku gsung thugs ye shes dag par bya ba la thog mar lag pa bkru ba ni/ oṃ hraḥsarba as+t+wa rā dza mā ra kle sha a n+ta kā ra badz+ra trīk+ṣ+ṇa duḥ

kha ts+tshed ma ma ka raṃ ba sho dh+ra ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lag pa phan tshun mnyes nas dag par bsam mo/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la/ a i ṛ u l̥/ bar pa'i tshigs lnga la/ a e er o al| rtse mo'i tshigs lnga la ha ya ra wa la ste dbyangs bco lnga'i bdag nyid las grub pa shin tu gang ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas mthe'u chung gi bar gyi rtse mo'i tshigs lnga la lā wa rā yā hā/ bar pa'i tshigs lnga la ā la au ār ai ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā ste dbyangs bco lnga'i bdag nyid las grub pa shin tu gang ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ lag pa gnyis zla nyi kha sbyar du gyur pa'i dbus su hūm̐ yig sngon po/ zla nyi dang sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcing*/ phyag rgya dang sngags kyis yan lag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar yan lag thams cad la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho he k+ṣaḥkā ya wā k+tsi ṣ+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa ti badz+ra kā ya ma ma kā ya wāk+tsi t+ta dz+nyā na badz+raṃ kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes rjod cing sngags don bsam mo/ /de nas nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kā ya swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjod cing bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur nga rgyal bya zhing 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bca'o/ /de nas yan lag drug dgod pa ni/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis bshibs te bgreng bas sngags don mchan du gsal ba'i gnas rnams su reg cing*/ oṃ hṝ hṛ da yā ya na maḥ oṃ hruṃ si ra si swā hā/ oṃ hṝṃ shi khā ye bau ṣa ṭa/ oṃ hrī ka ba tsā ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīṃ nai trā ya wa ṣa ṭa|

oṃ hrāḥ as+t+rā ya phaṭa/ phyogs thams cad mtshon chas bsrungs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ de ya si ra shi kha ka wa tsa nai tra as+t+ra badz+ra kha ṭaṃ ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko ྅haṃ/ zhes rjod cing nga rgyal bzung*/ oṃ

lā nā bhau na maḥ oṃ hruṃ hṛ da yā ya swā hā| oṃ hṛ gri wā yi bau ṣa ṭa/ oṃ hrī la la tra ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrāṃ shi kā ye wa ṣa ṭa/ oṃ hrāḥgu h+yā ya phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje thams cad kyi bdud gzhom pa'i sngon du dkar phyogs kyi zhing skyong la gtor ma byin nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i gtor ma bshams nas/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni badz+ra dhā trī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi shwadha ni sarba bra bya ṇi bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ sngar gyi phyag rgya dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgyas yul bdag dang*/ khyi'i phyag rgyas grong dang gnas kyi bdag po spyan drangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gzhi bdag grong bdag sa pa ri wā rā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gan+ti puṣ+pi dhū paṃ pra dī paṃ a k+ṣa taṃ da dā ma he sa pa ra wā ra shī gh+raṃ ā gats+tsha t+ya dzaḥhūm̐ bo hoḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na tu/ khā da tu/ pi wa tu| sa pa ri wā ra kaḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ shān+tiṃ puṣ+tiṃ rak+ṣa ā wa ra ṇa gāp+tiṃ ka ro tu i daṃ s+thā ni t+ye k+t+wa wā h+ya maṇ+ḍa la bhū myā tiṣ+ṭhan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ ces pa tshar gnyis dang*/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas te gtor sngags bod skad du bsgyur ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag grong bdag gnas kyi bdag /'khor dang bcas la gtor ma dri/ /me tog gdug pa sgron ma dang ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyi/ /'khor dang bcas rnams myur ba ru / / 'byon par mdzod dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma 'di ni bzung bar mdzod/ /gsol bar mdzod cig btung bar mdzod// 'khor dang bcas pa can rnams kyis/ /sems can thams cad zhi ba dang*// rgyas pa dang ni srung ba dang*/ /skyab dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/ /gnas 'di dor nas dkyil 'khor gyi/

/phyi yi sa la gnas par mdzod/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod/ swā hā/ de nas yan lag la rdo rje bkod nas rang nyid rdo rje'i skur sgom pa ni/ rang gi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po la āḥ dmar po las rdo rje dmar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ snying khar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor nag po la hūm̐ nag po las rdo rje nag po rtse mo dgu pa dang lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor ser po la ho ser po las rdo rje ser po rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang khu la haṃ ljang khu las rdo rje ljang khu rtse mo lnga pa dang gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sngon po la k+ṣa sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse mo sum bcu rtsa gsum pa phyi rol phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs g.yon gyi rtsa sum cu'i drug tshan lnga dang*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la rim pa bzhin du/ nga ngi ng-i ngu ngā+-i ngaṃ*/ gha ghi ghṛ ghu ghl̥ gh+raṃ/ ga gi gṛ gu gl̥ gh+laṃ/ kha khi khṛ khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kl̥ kaṃ rnams dang g.yas dang g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas mthe'u chung gi bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la rim pa bzhin du/ k+kāḥ k+kū k+kī k+kā/ kh+khāḥ kh+khū kh+khī kh+khā/ g+gāḥ g+gū g+gā / gh+ghāḥ gh+ghā gh+ghā+-i gh+ghī gh+ghā/ ng+nghāḥ ng+nghū d+dā d+dā| rnams las skyes pa'i rdo rje ljang khu re re/ nye ba'i dpung pa'i tshigs g.yon dang lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar gyi bar pa'i tshigs lnga la rim pa bzhin du/ nya dzha dza tsha tsa rnams sngar bzhin dang*/ g.yas dang g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas mthe'u chung gi bar gyi bar pa'i tshigs lnga la rim bzhin du/ ts+tsā tsh+tshā dz+dzā rnams snga ma bzhin las skyes pa'i rdo rje nag po re re/

de bzhin du 'don lugs snga ma bzhin sbyar nas/ 'khrig ma'i tshigs g.yon g.yas dang rtse mo'i tshigs la ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa rnams thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje dmar po re re/ spyi dang brla'i tshigs g.yon g.yas dang rkang pa g.yon g.yas kyi sor mo'i rtsa ba'i tshigs la pa pha ba bha ma rnams thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po re re/ dpus mo'i tshigs g.yon g.yas dang bar pa'i tshigs la ta tha da dha na rnams thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje ser po re re| long ba'i tshigs g.yon g.yas dang rtse mo'i tshigs la/ sa k+pa ṣa sha rnams thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje sngon po re re ste/ yan lag gi rdo rje cu gnyis po rnams rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang nying lag gi rdo rje drug cu po rnams rtse mo bdun pa'o/ /rna ba g.yon g.yas la a ā las rdo rje ljang khu re re dang sna bug g.yon g.yas la e ai las rdo rje nag po re re/ mig g.yon g.yas la ar ār las rdo rje dmar po re re dang*/ lce dang lce'u chung la o au las rdo rje dkar po re re/ rdo rje dang gsang gnas su al āl las rdo rje ser po re re dang yid dang khu ba'i rtsa a ba dhū tī'i yas sna dang mas sna la aṃ aḥlas rdo rje sngon po re re ste de thams cad kyang rtse mo gsum pa'o/ /gtsug tor dang mgo bo la ha hā las rdo rje ljang khu re re dang lce dang rkan la ya yā las rdo rje nag po re re/ lag mthil g.yon g.yas la ra rā las rdo rje dmar po re re dang*/ rkang mthil g.yon g.yas la wa wā las rdo rje dkar po re re/ bshang lam gyi g.yon g.yas la la lā las rdo rje ser po re re ste de thams cad kyang rtse mo lnga par gsal bas de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur/ de las me 'od 'phros pas bdud gzhom pa ni/ rdo rje de rnams las rang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i me 'od rab tu 'bar ba phyogs bcur spros te/

steng du ljang khu/ 'og tu sngon po/ shar dang shar lho nag lho dang lho nub dmar/ byang dang byang shar dkar/ nub dang nub byang ser ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba rnams kyis phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud kyi tshogs sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar sems pa thams cad nges par bsregs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥ ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la sarba ā wa ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kā yi ka bi gha bi nā ya ka ā dī nāṃ nga sha di ka ga tā nāṃ ka ya wā ka tsit+ta ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa bhasmiṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs pas thal bar gyur/ de nas srung 'khor la rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ bgegs gzhom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ oṃ hāṃ yā?ṃ rāṃ wāṃ lāṃ badz+ra ā kā sha wā yu te dza u da ka pṛ thī wī badz+ra swa bhā wa pañtsa dhā ta wo badz+ra maṇ+ḍa lā ni ku ru ku ru swā hā/ haṃ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha sbyar gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum bkra shis kyis mtshan pa steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha sbyar gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po pad+mas mtshan pa steng 'og du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha sbyar gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan ma steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha sbyar gyis brgyan pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ raḥ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sūr rā hū kā la ag+na ye kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā nā badz+ra pra kā rān ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po gcig tu 'dres pa las ra ba dang khang brtsegs gdan dang bcas pa grub par gyur pa ni/

nam mkha' dang sa 'byor ba zlum por snang ba'i mtshams su phyi nas/ rim pa bzhin du dkar dmar nag pa'i ra ba gsum dang*/ de'i phyi rol yul 'khor gyi mtshams su ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba'i ra ba lnga ste gnyis ka'ang rdo rje'i rang bzhin dbyibs zlum po steng 'og dang phyogs mtshams kun du bar mtshams med par gnas pa/ thams cad kyi 'og du mdung dang steng du mda'i dra ba rnon po dang 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ bi shwa kā ya badz+ra kū ṭā gha raṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ ra ba nang ma'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa steng 'og du khru nyis brgya pa'i nang du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa/ oṃ paḥbi shwa badz+ra pad+ma ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa khru bcu gnyis pa lte ba la khru bzhi yod pa/ oṃ raḥbadz+ra sū ra ā sa ni ku ru ku ru swā hā/ pad+ma'i lte bar lte ba dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang srung ma drug cu'i gnas su yang rang rang gi gdan dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ brten pa bskyed pa la gtso bo sgom pa ni/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po dbus sngo g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan zhing mdun nas g.yas skor gyis sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa/ zhal re re yang mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po gsum pa dkar po ste phrag pa drug dang dpung pa bcu gnyis/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dang po bzhi bzhi nag po gnyis pa bzhi bzhi dmar po gsum pa bzhi bzhi dkar po/ phyag lhag ma gnyis g.yas nag g.yon gser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser po/

mdzub mo dkar po| gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs pher dang po nag po gnyis pa dmar po gsum pa dkar po ste sor gdub rnams kyis mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba zhabs g.yas pa dmar po dang g.yon pa dkar pos bdud 'dod lha dang nyon mongs pa dbang phyug gi snying khar g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis mnan pa/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs thogs shing mgo bo dang thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ de'i rna g.yon g.yas la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su haṃ haḥ la sogs pa rang rang gi sa bon rnams las byung zhing mi rus las grub pa'i rdo rje rna rgyan la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams kyis legs par brgyan pa ni/ zhes brjod cing sngags don du gsal ba'i gnas rnams su phyag rgya 'ching zhing 'god do/ /oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣa ṇi kar+ṇa yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ aṃ aḥkaṭaṃ kan+ṭhe badz+ra me kha lā badz+ra kan+ṭhi ke hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a ā bā ma dak+ṣa ṇi ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa ko hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hā pā ma dak+ṣa ṇi pā da yor badz+ra nū pu re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ baṃ pañtsa kā ra ma tā shū n+ya swa bhā wa badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi si ra si sa rbāṃ ge bhasma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ aṃ ar+dha na re shwa ra badz+ra ar+dha tsan+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ur dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āḥ.aṃ sarba swa rai ka tri swa ra swa bhā wa badz+ra yā dz+nyo pa bi ta skan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣaḥ dur dān+ha a bhi mā na k+ṣa yaṃ ka ra bya gh+ra tsarma ka ṭo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥtriṃ shata swa ra sap+tā ti hra swa dīr+gha byañdza na swa bhā wa d+yai te ku la shata si ro bha ri muṇ+ḍa mā la skan+dha a ba laṃ bi ni skan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hi hṛ hu hl̥ pañtsa skan+dha bi shud dha swa bhā wa shi ra si ka pā la mā le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/

g.yas pa'i phyag bcu gnyis kyis k+ṣ+raḥrnams las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje dang rdo rje'i ral gri la sogs pa bcu gnyis bsnams pa ni/ zhes brjod cing rang rang gi phyag rgya g.yas pas bya zhing dag tu/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kro dha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra khaḍ+ga hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du khaḍ+ga'i gnas su tri shū la dang*/ karta ri dang*/ wā na dang*/ aṃ ku sha dang*/ ḍa ma ru ka dang*/ mud ga ra dang*/ tsakra dang*| kun+ta dang*/ daṇ+ḍa dang*/ par+shu rnams bzhug go /g.yon pa'i phyag bcu gnyis kyis hrāṃ rnams las byung pa'i rdo rje'i dril bu dang rdo rje'i phub la sogs pa bcu gnyis bsnams pa ni/ zhes rjod cing phyag rgya rnams g.yon pas byas la ngag tu/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho phreṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du ghaṇ+ḍe'i gnas su ṣe ṭa dang*/ kha ṭ+thaṃ ga dang*/ ka pā la dang*/ tsā pa dang*/ pā sha dang*/ rat+na dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ shang kha dang*| ā dar+sha dang*/ shriṃ kha le dang*/ tsa tur be da na swa bhu wa bra h+ma shi ra rnams bzhug go /oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣā k+ṣi k+ṣī k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣṝ k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣa/ ha hā hi hī ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥ sarba bi gh+na bi dhā ri ta ga dza tsat+ma ma ṭa ar+ṭa rak+ta shwi ta hūm̐ phreṃ/ glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag g.yon pa gnyis nas phyag tha ma gnyis kyis bzung te 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o| |de nas klu'i phyag rgya ni/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dza ya na ga in+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭa mu ku ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las byung pa'i klu rgyal ba ljang khus ral pa'i gcod pan bcings pa/ oṃ k+ṣuṃ badz+ra bi dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ k+ṣuṃ las byung ba'i rnam rgyal sngon pos dpral bar dar dpyangs su bcings pa|

oṃ h+yaṃ h+yā badz+ra ka rko ṭa badz+ra pad mau bām dak+ṣi ṇa kuṇ+ḍa la yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ h+yaṃ h+yā las byung ba'i stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos g.yon g.yas kyi rna ba brgyan pa/ oṃ hraṃ hrā badz+ra bā su ki shaṃ kha pā lo/ bām dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka ye tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hri hrā las byung pa'i nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po g.yon g.yas kyi lag gdub byas pa/ oṃ hwaṃ hwā badz+ra an n+ta ku li kau maṃ khalā ka n+ṭhi ka yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hw-i hwā las byung pa'i mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos rked pa dang mgul pa brgyan pa/ oṃ h+laṃ h+lā badz+ra tak+ṣa ko ma hā pad+mo pā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nū pur yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ h+laṃ h+lā las byung pa'i 'jog po dang pad chen ser pos g.yon g.yas kyi rkang gdub byas pa'o/ /skabs 'dir yang*/ rang gi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang*/ zhes pa nas bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dho in+d+ra a haṃ kro dhā ā dz+nyā da ya ka swā hā/ zhes rjod de khro bo'i dbang po'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /'khor spro ba la drug gi khro bo spro ba ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ha ya ra wa la dang*/ nga nya ṇa ma na dang*/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha dang*| ga dza ḍa ba da dang*/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha dang*/ ka tsa ṭa pa rta rnams re re zhing thung ring brtsegs pa rnams kyi nang nas/ ha hā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtsug tor can ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can dang gnod mdzes sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/

gnyis ka'ang phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste khang brtsegs nang gi 'khor lo'i steng dang 'og gi rtsibs la 'khod/ yi yī dang ral gri las skyes pa'i bgegs mthar byed dbyug sngon can nag po don grub lta bu sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung te shar dang shar lho'i rtsibs la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ri rī dang rin po che las skyes pa'i shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal dmar po rin 'byung lta bu mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste lho dang lho nub tu 'khod/ wu wū dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang mtha' lta bu lce dang chu lam nas phyung ste byang dang byang shar du 'khod/ ll̥ ll̥̄ dang 'khor la las skyes pa'i gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che rnam snang lta bu bshang lam dang rdo rje gtsug tor nas phyung ste nub dang nub byang du 'khod/ khro bo bcu bo thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes shing smin ma dang rmang ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ ye shes kyi khams dag pas khang brtsegs kyi nang srung ba'o/ /zad par spro ba ni/ nga ngā dang ni gri gug las skyes pa'i/ zad par nam mkha' ljang dang sngon po gnyis/ rtsa zhal rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste/ khang brtsegs steng dang gnod mdzes rgyal po yi/ /'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhir 'khod par gyur/ /nyi nyī dang ni ral gri las skyes pa'i/ /zad par rlung gnyis nag po sna bug ni/ /g.yon g.yas nas phyung shar dang shar lhor 'khod/ dang ni mda' las skyes pa yi/ /zad par me

gnyis dmar po mig dag ni/ /g.yon g.yas nas phyung lho dang lho nub 'khod// mu mū dang ni tho ba las skyes pa'i/ /zad par chu gnyis dkar po lce dang ni/ /chu lam nas phyung byang dang byang shar 'khod/ /nl̥ nl̥̄ dang ni 'khor lo las skyes pa'i// zad par sa gnyis ser po bshang lam dang*/ /gtsug tor nas phyung nub dang nub byang 'khod/ /zad par de rnams nam mkha'i khams dag pas/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i phyi rol srung ba'o/ /phyogs skyong spro ba ni/ /gha dang khab las skyes pa'i tshangs pa ljang khu zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis khab dang bgrang phreng g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa dang*/ /ghā dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i khyab 'jug sngon po g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang dbyug tho/ /g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste rab gsum pa'i steng du ngang pa dang 'og tu mkha' lding la 'khod/ dzhi dang ral gri las skyes pa'i bden bral nag po g.yas gnyis ral gri dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis phub dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang*/ /dzhī dang dpag bsam gyi shing las skyes pa'i rlung lha nag po g.yas gnyis dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du'i me tog g.yon gnyis dbang po sngon po dang ud pa la 'dzin pa sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste shar du yi dwags dang shar lhor ri dwags la 'khod/ ḍhṛ dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i gshin rje dmar po g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis lcags sgrog dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*/ ḍhṛ dang shak+ti lam skyes pa'i me lha dmar po g.yas gnyis shak+ti dang dbyug pa g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste lho ru ma he dang lho nub du lug la 'khod/ bhu dang zhags pa las skyes pa'i rgya mtsho dkar po g.yas gnyis zhags pa dang rin po che/ g.yon gnyis sbrul zhags dang chu shel 'dzin pa dang*/ bhūṃ dang rtse gsum la skyes pa'i drag po dkar po g.yas gnyis rtse gsum dang mda'|

g.yon gnyis sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa lce dang chu lam nas phyung ste byang du chu srin dang byang shar du khyu mchog la 'khod/ ngh-i dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dbang po ser po g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang me'i mda'/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa dang*/ dhā+-i dang be con las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin ser po g.yas gnyis rin po che dang be con/ g.yon gnyis ne'u le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa bshang lam dang rdo rje gtsug tor nas phyung ste nub tu glang po che dang nub byang du gzhal yas khang la 'khod/ tshangs pa las gzhan pa'i lha rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa ste/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rlung gi khams dag pas rab gsum pa'i nang srung ba'o/ /gza' spro ba ni/ ga gā dang ni gri gug las skyes pa'i/ /sgra gcan ljang dang dus me sngon po gnyis/ /rtsa zhal rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste/ /ra ba gsum pa'i phyi yi steng 'og 'khod/ /dza dzā ི dang ni ral gri las skyes pa'i/ /zla ba nyi ma nag po rna bug ni/ /g.yon g.yas nas phyung shar dang shar lhor 'khod// dang ni mda' las skyes pa yi/ /lhag pa mig dmar dmar po mig dag ni/ / g.yon g.yas nas phyung lho dang lho nub du 'khod/ /bu bu dang ni tho ba las skyes pa'i| |pa sangs phur bu dkar po lce dang ni/ /chu lam nas phyung byang dang byang shar 'khod/ / dang ni 'khor lo las skyes pa'i/ /'jug ring spen pa ser po bshang lam dang*/ /gtsug tor nas phyung nub dang nub byang 'khod/ /gza' chen de rnams me yi khams dag pas/ /rab gsum pa'i phyi rol srung ba'o/ /zad par rnams dang gza' rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste steng 'og pa rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing shar dang shar lho ba rnams ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing byang dang byang shar ba rnams tho ba dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/

nub dang nub byang ba rnams 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin cing thams cad kyang lha'i bu gos sna tshogs dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa rdo rje'i skyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /klu spro ba ni/ kha khā dang bum pa las skyes pa'i klu rgyal ba ljang khu dang rnam rgyal sngon po gnyis gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste ra ba lnga pa'i nang gi steng dang 'og tu 'khod/ tshi tshī dang rgyal mtshan las skyes pa'i stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag po gnyis sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste shar dang shar lhor 'khod/ dang bkra shis las skyes pa'i nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po gnyis mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste lho dang lho nub du 'khod/ phu phū dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas phyung ste byang dang byang shar du 'khod/ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i 'jog po dang pad chen ser po gnyis bshang lam dang rdo rje gtsug tor nas phyung ste nub dang nub byang du 'khod| klu lhag ma brgyad po gdengs ka lnga lnga dang ldan zhing thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis bum pa dang rdo rje g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ lha'i gos kyis bklubs shing rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras te rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa/ chu'i khams dag pas ra ba lnga pa'i nang srung ba'o| |'byung po spro ba ni/ ka kā dang gri gug las skyes pa'i ro langs ljang khu dang grul bum sngon po gnyis rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste ra ba lnga pa'i phyi rol gyi steng dang 'og tu 'khod/ tsi tsī dang gri gug las skyes pa'i mi'am ci khyi'i gdong can dang skyes bu'am ci bya rog gi gdong can nag po gnyis sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste shar dang shar lhor 'khod/ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dri za phag gdong can dang 'byung po bya rgod gdong can dmar po gnyis mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste lho dang lho nub tu 'khod/

pu pū dang gri gug las skyes pa'i srin po stag gdong can dang yi dgas 'ug gdong can dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas phyung ste byang dang byang shar du 'khod/ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i rjed byed lce spyang gi gdong can dang mkha' lding mkha' lding gi gdong can ser po gnyis bshang lam dang rdo rje gtsug tor nas phyung ste nub dang nub byang du 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba 'phyang zhing zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sa'i khams dag pas ra ba lnga pa'i phyi rol srung ba'o| |zad par dang gza' dang klu dang 'byung po thams cad kyang steng 'og pa rnams stong pa'i dkyil 'khor dang shar dang shar lho ba rnams rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams me'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ nub dang nub byang ba rnams sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /ye shes pa bzhug pa ni/ rang gi snying khar hūm̐ thung dang*/ rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs 'od zer sngon po 'jigs pa'i sku can rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal bzhi mche ba phyed gtsigs shing sgra drag po sgrog pa/ spyan bcu gnyis dang ldan zhing phyag nyi shu rtsa drug dang zhabs gnyis pa/ shes rab dang thabs las rab tu byung zhing gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i lpags pa dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ thod pa dang mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang zhing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig spros te/ des bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i gtso bo'i lte bar lcags kyus bsnun/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug po rnams sbrul zhags kyis bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis 'jigs par byas te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

badz+ra bhai ra wa ya ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ rdo rje shugs rang gi snying khar thiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe mā le dhū pa nas/ kā me artsa na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ shes rab mthar byed kyis rdo rjes dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug ya mān+ta kṛta baṃ/ gshin rje mthar byed kyis zhags pas dbyer med du bcings/ pad mān+ta kṛta ho/ pad+ma mthar byed kyis dril bus mnyes par byas| bi n+ta kṛta hi/ bgegs mthar byed kyis dbyug pas ro mnyam par byas/ zhes rjod cing de rnams kyi phyag rgya bya'o/ /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni ma gsungs shing rdo rje bkod pas dod thub du 'gyur ro/ /dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas| dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe mā le sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ haṃ hrī hiṃ hīṃ hṛ hrī huṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥ṃ/ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ badz+ra ḍā ki ṇ+yau badz+ra a mṛ gha ṭe ra a bhi ṣiñtsa tu ma swā hā/ zhes gsol ba btab pas yum lngas chu'i dbang bkur/ oṃ aṃ iṃ ṛ u liṃ sarba bud dhā badz+ra mu ku ṭaṃ ma ma pañtsa bud dha āt+ma kaṃ ban dha yan+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas yab lngas cod pan gyi dbang bkur/ oṃ a ā/ aṃ iḥha hā haṃ haḥ phreṃ ho sarba pā ra mi tā ma ma badz+ra paṭ+ṭaṃ ban+dha yan+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas nus ma rnams kyis dar dpyangs kyi dbang bkur/ oṃ huṃ ho bi dz+nyā na swa bhā we ka ka ru pradz+nyā āt+ma ke badz+ra badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe sa bya ta ra ka ra yor ma ma badz+ra satwaḥ sa pradz+nyo da dā tu zhes gsol ba btab pas gtso bo yab yum gyis rdor dril gyi dbang bkur| oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl aṃ āḥsarba bo dhi satwaḥ sabhār+ya/ sarba dā sarba kā ma u pa bho gaṃ badz+ra bra taṃ ma ma dang dā n+tu swā hā/

zhes gsol ba btab pas sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis brtul zhugs kyi dbang bkur/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā sarba kro dha rā dzaḥs bhā r+ya mai tri ka ru ṇa mu bī ta u pek+ṣa sarba sa mi tā swa bha wa badz+ra pū rbāṃ ga ma nā ma me da dānū hu hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes gsol ba btab pas khro bo khro mo rnams kyis ming gi dbang bkur/ oṃ e waṃ pad+ma badz+ra/ tsih+nau pradz+nyau pā yo maṇ+ḍa la a dhi pa ti badz+ra su khadz+nyā nāṃ gaṃ ma ma da dra taṃ haṃ haḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpas rjes gnang gi dbang bskur| de ltar dbang bdun thob pas sa bdun gyi dbang phyug tu gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sap+ta a bhi ṣe ka sap+ta bhū mi prap+to haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /oṃ oṃ pradz+nyau pā yo badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas phyag rgya'i nu ma la reg pa las skyes pa'i bde stong gi ye shes bum pa'i dbang thob nas sa brgyad kyi dbang phyug du gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra sa twe na badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ka ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twa pu tro a tsa la bhū mi lab+dho haṃ/ zhes rjod de nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyau pā yo gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas byang sems dkar dmar myangs pa las skyes pa'i bde stong gi ye shes gsang ba'i dbang thob nas sa dgu'i dbang phyug du gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sa twe na gu h+ya a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twa yu ba rā dzo na wa bhū mi lab+dho haṃ/ oṃ huṃ pradz+nyau pa yo badz+ra sa twa bi shwa mā ha ro pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da da tāṃ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pa las byung pa'i lhan skyes kyi dga' ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob nas sa bcu'i dbang phyug du gyur/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra sa twe na pradz+nya dz+nyā ne na abhi ṣe ka ṇa a bhi ṣi k+to dwi tī yo badz+ra dha ro haṃ dharma me gha bhū mi lab+dho haṃ/

o ho pradz+nyau pā yo āt+ma kaṃ badz+ra sa twa ma hā mu drā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me pra yats+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥphaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dang rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi sku ni 'di'o zhes brda sprad pa'i tshig gi sgo nas dbang gong ma'i gong ma thob pas sa bcu gnyis kyi dbang phyug tu gyur/ oṃ ho dha rma dhā twak+ṣa ra tsa tur+tha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twe na āt+ma naṃ a haṃ dwi tī yo dwa da sha b+tū mi lab+dho badz+ra sa twa ma hā ar+thaḥ pa ra ma ak+ṣa raḥ tre lokya bi dza ya kā la tsakro bha ga wan e waṃ kā ra/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ / de ltar dbang bcu gcig gis dbang bkur pas dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ste/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa ni/ gtso bo dang steng gi rnams la mi bskyod pa shar dang shar lho ba rnams la don grub/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung*/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams la snang mtha'/ nub dang nub byang ba rnams la rnam snang*/ 'og gi rnams la rdor sems te de rnams sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu rgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par gyur/

gsum pa bgegs gzhom pa la/ phur bus gdab pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rang gi lus kyi rdo rje de rnams las rang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje zhes pa nas/ bgegs rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs pas thal bar gyur/ bgegs dang log 'dren las sogs pa gnas gzhan du bros pa dang ma tshigs pa rnams rdo rjai shugs kyis rdo rje lcags kyus bkug badz+ra bhai ra a ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ mi g.yo bas rdo rje zhags pas lag pa bcings shing rkang pa lcags sgrogs gis bsdams/ badz+ra pā she na sarba bhu dze ṣu ban+dha ya ba n+d+ra ya/ badz+wa shriṃ kha lā ya sarba pā de ṣu ni ro dha ya ni ro dha ya/ mtha' yas brtson 'grus kyis ha ya ra wa la'i yi ge lnga thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje phur bu bcu stod khro bo zhal drug phyag drug pa lte ba'i 'og man chad zhabs drug dang bcas pa mdung rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa ltar gnas pa phyogs bcur bgegs rnams kyi mgo bor zug oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho hi k+ṣaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra kī la ya kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa ti ṣa ṇa mu kha ṣā ṇa bhu dza ṣa ṭa tsa ra ṇa sarba bi gh+na bi nā ya ka ā dī duṣ+ta nāṃ kā ya waka tsit+ta dz+nyā nā ni kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyug sngon can gyis rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar du phug ste gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags pas lus kyi g.yo 'gul ngag gi smra brjod yid kyi rnam rtog thams cad dang bral nas bgegs thams cad 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang du gnas par gyur/ oṃ ll̥̄ badz+ra mung ga ra mā ra a dī nāṃ si ra si kan+ṭhe hṛ da ya nā bhau gu h+ya an+te badz+ra kri la kran/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya k+ṣa k+ṣā k+ṣi k+ṣīṃ k+ṣū k+ṣūṃ k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar bkod pa'i phur bu dang bcas pa'i phyogs thams cad khro bo bcus bsrungs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bka' bsgo bar bya ste|

oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dhā rā dza ma hā u ṣ+ṇī ṣa ur dh+wa di shi re k+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ hā badz+ra kro dha rā dzā sum bha a bho di shi rak+ṣ-i ku ru ku ru swā hā/ aṃ yaṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti ba la sarba bi gh+nan+ta ka pū rba di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ yāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dzā nī la daṇ+ḍa ag+ni yaṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ raṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza dza m+bha ka nguṣ+taṃ pradz+nyān+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ rāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki rā dza nai ri taṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ a waṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+ma n+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ wāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la ī shā na de shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ la badz+ra kro dha rā dza stam+bha ka ya mān+ta ka pa sh+tsi ma di shir k+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ lāḥ badz+ra kri dha rā dza ma hā ba la wa ya byaṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā| de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ na mo badz+ra sa twā ya/ na mo bud dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra kro dha ne rā dze bh+ya: na mo bi shwa mā tā/ na mo bud dha bo dhi sa twa di wī bh+ya: na mo badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te kā la tsakrā ya/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhī ka rā ya/ ma he n+d+ra nī la war+ṇa sha rī rā ya/ mā ra kle sha hṛ da ya kran+ta si ta rak+ta tsa ra ṇā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa rak+ta si ta ka n+ṭha ya/ nī la si ta pī ta rak+ta daṃ ṣ+ta ka rā lo kra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa rak+ta si ta sa bya ta ra skan+dhā ya/ dwa da sha bhu dzā ya/ ṣaṭa bid sha ti ka rā ya/ badz+ra kha ḍ+ga tri shū la karte ka wā na aṃ ku sha ḍa ma ru ka mu da ga ra tsakra kun+ta daṇ+ḍa par shu/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe kheṭa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la tsā pa pā sha rat+na ka ma la|

shaṃ kha ā dar sha shriṃ kha lā brah+ma shi rog dza tsarma dhṛka ka rā ya/ byagh+ra tsarma ni wa sa nā ya/ kan+dhe muṇ+ḍa mā lā ba laṃ bi ni shi ra si badz+ra paṭ+ṭa mu ku ṭa badz+ra ka pā la mā la ar+dha tsan+da dha rā ya/ ku ṇ+ḍa la ru tsaka kan+ṭhi ka me kha lā nū pu ra bhasma ya dz+nyo pa bi ta shi ro ma ṇi ma hā mu drā nā gen+d+ra bi bhū ṣa ṇā ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī san+to ṣi ta hṛ da yā ya/ in+d+ra ag+ni ya ma nai ri t+ya wa ru ṇa wā yu ku be ra ī sha na brah+ma biṣ+ṇu bi nā ya ka karti ke ya nan+di ma hā kā la grahan k+ṣa tra k+ṣe tra pā la su ren+d+ra a su ren+d+ra pha ṇī n+d+ra bhū ten+d+ra na ren+d+ra saṃ stut+ta tsa ra ṇā ya/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ kā la tsakra dur ban+ta da ma ka dza ti dza ra mā ra ṇa an+ta ka trai lokya bi dza ya/ ma hā bī re shwa ra badz+ra bhai ra wa/ badz+ra kā ya/ badz+ra gā tra/ badz+ra ne tra/ badz+ra sho tra/ badz+ra gh+ra ṇa/ badz+ra dzi hā/ badz+ra ban+ta/ badz+ra na kha/ badz+ra ke sha badz+ra lo ma/ badz+ra ā bha ra ṇa/ badz+ra ha sa/ badz+ra gī t+ya/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya/ badz+ra a yu dha ka ra/ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a dhi pa ti/ badz+ra ḍā ka badz+ra ḍā ki nī dzā la pa ri bri ta/ shī gh+raṃ/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā ya sar+b+ba mā ra bi ghaṃ/ binā ya ka kiṃ na ra/ kiṃ pu ru ṣa ga ru ḍa/ gan+dha rba/ yak+ṣa| rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ ma hā pre ta/ ku m+b+lan+ṭa/ a pa smā ra/ k+ṣe tra pā la/ be tā ḍa/ pū ta na/ duṣ+ta nā ga graha/ ā da yo ye/ sar+b+ba dz+wa ra sar+b+ba byā/ dhi k+ṣu tro ba dra wa kā ri ṇi| a su ran+d+ra/sar+b+ba sa twā nāṃ/ sar+b+ba a pa kā ra ra tāṃ stān/ sar+b+ba n+dza shī gh+raṃ/ badz+ra aṃ ku she na ā/ kṛ ṣ+ya.ā kraṃ ṣ+ya/ ur+dhā di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pūrba di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ dak+ṣ-i ṇa di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ ut+ta ra di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pash+tsi ma di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/

wā ya bya di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ ī shā na di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ nai ri t+ya di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ ag+na ye di shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ a dho ngi shi ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ ā kā sha maṇ+ḍa la ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ wā yu maṇ+ḍa la ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ te dzo maṇ+ḍa la ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ to ya maṇ+ḍa la ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pṛ thī wī maṇ+ḍa la ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ kā ma dhā tu ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ rū pa dhā tu ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ a rū pa dhā tu ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ kā ya dhā tu ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ wā ka dhā tu ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ tsit+ta dhā tu ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pañtsa skan+dha ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pañtsa dhā du ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pañtsa in+d+ra ya ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pañtsa bi ṣa ya ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pañtsa kar+m+ma in+d+ri ya ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ pañtsa kar+m+ma in+d+ri ya bi ṣa ya ga tā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ sar+b+ba to ya tra ku ṭa tsita ga hā na ā kṛ ṣ+ya ā kṛ ṣ+ya/ ma hā sh+mā sha ne badz+ra ag+ni dz+ral ti bhū myāṃ ni bā ta ya ni pā ta ya/ badz+ra pā she na sar+b+ba bhu dze ṣu ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ badz+ra shriṃ khal yā sar+b+ba pā de ṣu ne ro dha ya ni ro dha ya/ sar+b+ba sa te ṣu kā ya wāk+tsi t+ta ma hā kro dha badz+re ṇa tsur+ṇa ya/ badz+ra khaḍ+ge na ni krin+ta ya ni krin+ta ya/ badz+ra tri shū le na bhe da ya bhe da ya/ badz+ra karti ke ya ha na ha na| badz+ra bā ne na bhin+da bhin+da/ badz+ra kī la keḥ kī la ya kī la ya/ badz+ra mung ga re ṇa ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ badz+ra tsakre ṇa ts+tshe da ya ts+tshe da ya/ badz+ra kun+te na bhen+de bhin+da/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍe na tā ḍa ya tā ḍa ya/

badz+ra par shu nā ts+tshi n+da ts+tshin+da/ sār+ngha tri kro ṭi kha ṇ+ḍaṃ kṛ twa sh+mā shā na bhū myaṃ sar+b+ba bhū h+ya bh+yo ba liṃ ku ru ku ru/ badz+ra ḍa ma ru ke na badz+ra ḍā ki nīr āwa ha ya ā wa ha ya/ badz+ra ḍā kinī bh+yo mā ra kā yi kā nāṃ ru dhi raṃ na be da ya ni be da ya/ pañtsa a mṛ ta dhā rī ṇī bh+yaḥ pañtsa a mṛ ti ni bed ya ni bed ya/ sar+b+ba badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa hi taḥ sar+b+ba sa twā nā shā ka'o/ kāṃ rak+ṣa ā wa ra ṇa gu bhiṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces pa bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi yan lag so so'i 'phreng sngags rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang*/ sngar gyi bka' bsgo ba'i sngags rnams mang nyung ci rigs pa bzlas te/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣaṃ ku ru āt+ma ko haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal bzung la/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa wa ra a r+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha/ zhes sogs/ chu bzhi dang lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal| |rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod| de nas gtor ma ni/ gtso bo la gcig dang 'khor kun la gcig te gnyis sam/ bdun nam/ drug cu rtsa gcig la sogs pa chu dang chang dang nang mchod kyis bran te/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri ga gan swa bhā wa sar+b+ba dra bya bi sho dha ni sar+b+ba dra bya ṇi bi sho dha ya huṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ kyis gsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu yi dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar ba'i steng du āḥlas bum pa bdud rtsis gang pa'i sgyid bu gsum la gnas shing*/

oṃ las skyes pa'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su a las byang sems dkar po as mtshan pa/ shar du i las rkang mar is mtshan pa| lhor ṛ las rak+ta ṛs mtshan pa/ byang du u las dri chu us mtshan pa/ nub du l̥ las dri chen las mtshan pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ slar yang rlung dbang ldan srin po me dbus rnams su l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā rnams las glang po che/ ba glang*/ rta/ khyi| mi rnams kyi sha la yi ge de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i rlung gis sbar ba'i mes bzhu ste de nyid hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes dkrugs pas de dang bcas pa ro gcig tu gyur nas zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i sku rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku rdo rje spyan drangs/ des 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sku rdo rje'i bdud rtsi thams cad bsdus nas gcig tu gyur pa dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs nas skyon med par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+t+ra sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥsu bi shud dhaḥ srabhā wa sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma na bi sho dha ya swā hā/ lag pa g.yas pa āḥ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdang pad+ma las skyes pa'i gsung rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ces sogs 'don pa spos nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas rdzas rnams mang por sbar zhing bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par rtogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sū r+ya sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥ prabho dha ka sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma na pra bha dha ya swā hā/ snyim pa hūm̐ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i thugs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs sbyar nas 'dres pas rdzas rnams rab tu 'bar zhing kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la sarba dharmaḥ pra da'i pa ka sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma na pra dī pa ya swā hā/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya ho las dus me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ho dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i ye shes rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs sbyar nas/ 'dres pas zag bcas kyi dri ma bsags nas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ ho sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma na badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de bzhi la rim pa bzhin g.yon g.yas kyi lag mthil dang snyim pa mkha' lding gi phyag rgya rnams gtor ma la bstan no/ /rang gi lag pa gnyis la haṃ/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan so so'i gzugs su gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas gtor mgron rnams spyan drangs/ 'gron rnams kyi ljags rdo'i sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur zhes rjod cing*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ u ṣ+ṇī ṣasum+bha ni sum+bha bi gh+nā n+ta kanī la daṇ+ḍa pradz+nyān+ta ka ṭak+ki rā dza pad+mān+ta ka a tsa la ya mān+ṭa ka ma hā ba le bh+yaḥ zhes rjod/ zad par la gri gug gi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ.ā kā sha wa yu te dza u da ka pṛ thī wī sā dhi bh+yeḥ phyogs skyong la ral gri'i phyag rgya bcas te| oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ prah+ma biṣ+ṇu nai ri t+ya wā yu yam ag+ni sa mu dra ī shwa ra in+d+ra yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ gza' la rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrā hu/ kā la ag+ni/ tsan+t+ra/ sūr+ya| bu dha/ maṃ ga la/ shukra/ bṛ ha sba te/ ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥklu la pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas ste/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa/ bā+e su ki shaṃ kha pa la/ ku li ka a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka ma hā pad+me bh+yaḥ

'byung po la 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbe tā ḍa/ bi kṛ ta mu khaḥshwa kā ka sū ka ra/ gṛ ḍha/ byagh+ra/ ū lu ka dzam+bu ka ga ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gan+dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ hūm̐ paṃ pra di paṃ ak+ṣa taṃ dang dā ma he te dza ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā ra shī gh+raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na n+tu/ khā dan+tu/ pi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsan+t+ri p+ta/ sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ puṣ+tiṃ rak+ṣa ā/ wa ra ḍa gu p+tiṃ kurba n+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams tshar gnyis rjod/ de nas rdor dril 'dzin pas sngags de bod skad du bsgyur ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed| |gtsug gtor gnod mdzes nges gnod mdzes/ /bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug pa sngo/ /shes rab mthar byed 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /pad+ma mthar byed mi g.yo ba/ /gshin rje mthar byed stobs chen rnams/ /nam mkha' rlung me chu dang ni| |sa yi zad par grub pa rnams/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug bden bral rlung*// gshin rje me dang rgya mtsho dang*/ /dbang phyug dbang po gnod sbyin rnams/ /sgra gcan dus me zla nyi ma/ /lhag pa bkra shis khu ba dang*/ /phur bu dal 'gro mjug ring rnams/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal pad stobs rgyu/ /nor rgyas dung skyong rigs ldan dang*| |mtha' yis 'jog po pad chen rnams/ /ro langs rnam rgyal 'gyur zhal khyi| |bya rog phag dang bya rgod stag /'ug pa spye lcang khyung gdong rnams/ /'khor bcas rnams la gtor ma dri/ /me tog gdug pa sgron ma dang*/ /ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyi/ /'khor bcas de rnams myur byon nas/ /gtor ma 'di ni bzung bar mdzod/ /gsol bar mdzod cing btung bar mdzod/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang dag tshim/ /sems can thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /rgyas pa dang ni bsrung ba dang*// bskyab dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/

/hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod| |swā hā/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha/ sogs chu bzhi lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyis bstod| |rgyas pa la spro na gtso bo dang sde tshan re re'i mthar yang*/ /sngags la sa pa ri wā re bh+ya gan+dhaṃ man chad dang*/ /bod skad la 'khor bcas rnams la gtor ma dri man chad btags pa dbul lo/ /de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ lag pa'i rgyab bstan cing se gol gtogs la k+ṣaḥgasang gnas kyi 'khor lor haṃ la khro bo/ /gtsug gtor gyi aṃ la zad par/ dpral bar i la phyogs skyong*// mgrin par ṛ la gza'/ snying khar u la klu/ lte bar l̥ la 'byung po rnams thim par gyur/ zhes rjod cing bsam mo/ /'di ni srung 'khor rgyas pa ste 'bring du byed na gzhan 'dra ba la gtso bo la khro bo bcus bskor ba tsam bsgom pa dang*/ gtso rkyang rgyan dang phyag mtshan sngags kyis ma bkod par sgoms/ /bsdus par byed na rdo rje'i skur bsgoms nas bgegs bsreg pa'i bar tsam byas kyang rung ste sngon 'gro bsrung 'khor ro// // sgrub thabs dngos la yang sbyor ba tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ dngos gzhi yan lag bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa'o| |dang po la bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/

/rang nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lor/ gsal ba'i thugs khar paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ aṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkha'i mthil du spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying kha'i zla ba rdo rje la thim/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye dang 'jig pa med| |shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par bcas kyang rnam med bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma nges rab tu 'khyud/ /skye 'jig spangs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba dang ldan bzhad pa la sogs bde ba spangs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bskyed mdzad sku gsum dag dang ldan zhing dus gsum yang dag rig /kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe sogs bcu gnyis brjod/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /chags dang zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /bgyis dang bgyid rtsal yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /'phags pa rnams kyi dge tshogs dang*/ /gzhan yang dge ba ci mchis la/ /mngon par dga' bas yi rang ngo*/ /nyon mongs nad kyis gdungs pa yi/ /skye bo bde bar gso phyir du/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bdud rtsi yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /ma rtogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /mya ngan 'da' bzhed spangs nas ni/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag tshul gyis/ /bskal pa mtha' yas bzhugs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas slob dpon dbang mchog thob/ /nges bstan thabs shes dbyer med chos/ /der gnas dge 'dun rnam gnyis la/

/rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid rnam pa kun du 'bul/ /yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bran dang 'bangs su bzung du gsol/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /rang don dri mas ma gos par/ /srid gsum sems can ma lus pa// sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /byang chub sems ni skyed bgyi zhing*/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa bskyed/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa spang*/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs smon lam/ /stobs dang ye shes pha rol phyin/ /tshogs gsum don du bsgrub par bgyi/ /sems can bde dang ldan pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal dang ni bral ba dang*/ /bde la rtag tu gnas par dga'/ /mnyam nyid btang snyoms bsgom par bgyi/ /sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos te/ /snyan par smra ba'i gtam byas nas/ /don spyod pa yis bag phab te/ /don mthun gros chen gdab par bgyi/ /lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi las ni rnam gsum ste/ /mi dge bcu po spang bar bgyi| |bslab pa gsum la sgrib pa yi/ /'gyod dang rmugs pa gnyid dang ni| |rgod pa dang ni the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po spang bar bgyi/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang dang*/ /gti mug dang ni nga rgyal te/ /srid pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa yi/ /nyon mongs bzhi po spang bar bgyi/ /'dod pa'i zag dang srid pa'i zag |ma rig pa yi zag pa dang*/ /lta ba'i zag ste 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /zag pa bzhi po spang bar bgyi/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med/ /smon med mngon par 'dus ma byas/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi yis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par bgyi| |zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod do/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /bsgom pa bsgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/

/bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas 'khor ba'i phung po spangs te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po bzung ba'i phyir| rang gi lus kyi chus me nyams par byas/ me dang bral ba'i sa chu la thim/ chu rlung gis bskams/ rlung nam mkha' la thim pas khams gsum po thams cad rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi snang ba rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i rnam thar sgo bzhi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko ྅haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ūt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a na bhi saṃ skar dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjod do/ / dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchogathig le'i rnal 'byor| phra mo'i rnal 'byor bzhi las dang po la rten dang brten pa bskyed pa gnyis kyi dang po la dngos dang rnam dag gnyis kyi dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa can thad kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du waṃ la chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dkyil 'khor bzhi ka yang steng 'og du hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du maṃ las lhun po chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang*/ steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga cu pa| de'i steng du k+ṣaṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma ri rab kyi steng gi rgya'i phyed dang mnyam pa'i sum cha lte ba la yod pa/

de'i steng du haṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du tsheg drag las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa la sa yi yi ger gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rlung me chu sa ri rab pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan dang bcas pa mdog dbyibs mtshan ma dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng du hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi la bh+ruṃ yongs su gyur pa las sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nor bu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba can ste sku'i dkyil 'khor phyi nas rim pa bzhin du ser dkar dmar nag ldang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor phyi nas sogs nas/ lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyis thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ gsum ka'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin gyi rta babs bzhi bzhis brgyan pa/ rta babs so so la ka ba bzhi bzhi'i bar du lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i rtseg ma gsum pa/ rtseg 'og ma la glang po che'i mgo bor seng ges mnan pa dang bar ma dang steng ma la shā pa bha ñdzi kas snam bu steg pa/ snam bu so so'i rtse mor rgyal mtshan bgreng zhing rnga yab dang me long dang dril bu dang ba da na dkar po rnams 'phyang ba| thams cad kyi steng du har mi/ de'i steng gi dbus su bum pa dang g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ ka ba'i sham nas myos pa bsrung bas bskor ba'o/ /sku'i rta babs kyi rtseg 'og ma'i dbus kyi shar du hūm̐ las chos 'khor nag po'i g.yas g.yon du ri dgas pho mo/ lho ru āḥlas bum pa bzang po dmar po'i g.yas g.yon du dung dang pad+ma/

byang du oṃ las tsho dkar po'i g.yas g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub du ho las byang chub kyi shing ser po'i g.yas g.yon du mi'am ci pho mo/ rtsig pa so so'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po la rin po che'i 'ching pa rnam par bkra ba/ de'i steng du do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang me long dang rnga yab dang dril bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dkar po dang de'i steng du kra ma shir+ṣa pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dkar pos 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor zhing sgo khyung dang ka ba'i mtshams su rin po che dang zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rtsig pa so so'i nang du rtsig pa la ma reg pa'i lha snam dkar po steng gi thog dang bcas pa'o/ /thugs 'khor gyi nang gi phyed kyi tshang du ye shes kyi 'khor lo gru bzhi rdo rje'i phreng ba ljang khus bskor ba la rten pa'i shar du ral gri nag po lhor rin po che dmar po byang du pad+ma dkar po nub du 'khor lo ser pos spras pa'i ka ba nag po bcu drug gis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mo rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i rtog gis spras pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyis bde chen gyi 'khor lo gru bzhi rdo rje'i phreng ba nag pos bskor zhing oṃ las skyes pa'i gtso bo'i pad+ma ljang khu 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar aṃ las zla ba/ aḥlas nyi ma/ a las sgra gcan gyi gdan/ gshegs pa dang gshegs ma la sogs pa lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su yang rang rang gi gdan rnams rdzogs par grub pa'i thugs 'khor gyi pad+ma thams cad oṃ yig las skyes shing zla ba thams cad a yig dang nyi ma thams cad ni ra yig dang gsung 'khor phan gyi pad+ma thams cad paṃ yig las grub pa'o/

/gzhal yas khang gi nang gi sa gzhi dang steng gi thog thams cad dbus sngo shar nag lho dmar byang dkar nub ser ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i sa la pad+ma dang bum pa la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin dpung mtha' yas pas mdzes shing phyi nas sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i khor yug rnams kyis bskor ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan mtshams su aṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba shar zhing bden bral gyi 'tshams su āḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub ba/ me rlung khor yug gi mtshams su dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor zhing nam mkha'i khor yug la rdo rje'i ra ba dang de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me ri 'od zer 'bar bas bskor ba'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis las lus kyi khams kyi rnam dag ni/ ka ba rnams dang rdo rje'i phreng ba sa yi dkyil 'khor rtsig pa nyid ni rus pa rnams kyis mdzod/ sha khrag chu dang bshang ba rnams kyis lha dang gshin rje nor sbyin gzhan du rdul tshon gdab pa ste/ 'khris pa bad kan gyis ni nyi ma ri bong can yang de bzhin chu rgyas rnams kyis chu skyes rnams/ /ra ba lnga yi re khā sa dang chu dang bsreg pa rlung dang nam mkha' las skyes rnams kyis so/ /dus kyi rtsa yis gtso bo'i chu skyes g.yo ba me yi dkyil 'khor la sogs lpags pa la sogs kyis/ /nyi ma'i sgo rnams bug pa rnams kyis nor bu'i rang bzhin bkod pa so yi phreng bas de bzhin nyid/ dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas rnams ni sor mo rnams kyi ser mo yis/ /ba spu rnams kyis rdo rje'i me lce dkyil 'khor gyi ni mtha' ru phyogs dang phyogs bral dag la gnas/ /ces dang*/ chos kyi phung po'i rnam dag ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ches/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rnams kyis ni/ /rdo rje'i thig ni bzhi po ste/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams kyis/

/kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog pa yis/ /sgo ni bcu gnyis po rnams te/ /de bzhin sa ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /rta babs dag ni mdzes pa rnams/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams kyis/ /phyogs brgyad du ni dur khrod rnams/ /stong nyid bcu drug ka ba ste/ khams rnams kyis kyang khang pa brtsegs/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sgo khyung rnams| |gzugs can yon tan brgyad rnams kyis/ /'gram rnams dang ni logs rnams nyid/ /thugs gsung sku yi dbye bas so/ /tshul khrims la sogs phung po lngas/ kha dog lnga ni rnam sbyangs pa/ /theg pa gsum gyis ra ba gsum| |dad pa'i dbang po sogs kyis lnga/ /dad sogs stobs rnams dag gis lnga/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor la'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzugs rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la kha khyer te/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa yis/ /rin chen rnam bu rnam par bkra/ /ma 'dres chos ni bco brgyad kyis| |do shal phyed pa de rnams nyid/ /dbang rnams kyis kyang ba ku li/ /dge bas kra ma shi rā'o/ /stong nyid la sogs rnam thar gyis/ /dril bu'i sgra ni rdzogs pa ste/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas rgyal mtshan gtams/ /spong bas me long rab tu 'bar/ /byang chub yan lag rnga yab g.yo/ /yan lag dgu'i phreng bas brgyan// bsdu ba bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ /zur du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /bden pa rin chen bzhi rnams kyis/ /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams su spros/ /mngon shes lnga yis rtag tu ni/ /zlum skor chen po lnga yis bskor/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen byang chub pas| |rdo rje phreng bas legs par bskor/ /bde ba gcig pu'i lcags ri yis/ /de bzhin ye shes rdo rje 'bar/ /shes rab thabs kyi cha yis ni/ /zla ba nyi ma rtag tu 'char/ /thugs gsung sku dang yang dag dag /chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa bzang*/ /rnga bo che dang byang chub shing*/ /de ni yid bzhin nor bu sogs/

/'di dag dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings dang ldan| |ces pa rnams don dran bzhin pas brjod nas rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang rdul bran bsags pa'i bem po'i chos bu 'dzin pa zlog par bya'o/ / gnyis pa la gtso bo yab yum mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang*/ de'i mngal nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor spro ba dang*/ spros pa'i dkyil 'khor du sems can la snying rje'i dbang bskur sbyin pa dang*/ shin du rnam par dag pa'i nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dbus kyi zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba la yar ngo'i tshes gcig la sogs pa'i ngo bo/ a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la aṃ rnams g.yon bskor dang*/ mar ngo'i tshes gcig la sogs pa'i ngo bo lā wā rā yā hā/ ā la au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ū+i ā/ aḥrnams g.yas skor te mtshan so gnyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ l+la ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 y+ya ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 ḍha/ l+la ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 y+ya

/ s+sa ṣ+ṣa sh+sha / t+ta ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 d+da dha n+na/ p+pa ph+pha ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 m+ma/ ṭ+ṭa ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 ḍ+ḍa ṇ+ṇa/ ts+tsa tsh+tsha dz+dza / k+ka kh+kha g+ga gh+gha ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 / rnams g.yas skor dang*/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa| na dha da tha ta/ sha ṣa ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la ha/ rnams g.yon skor te dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su dri za'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig ri bong gi mtshan ma lta bu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de gsum gcig tu 'dres pa las rnam shes kyi gzhon pa srog rlung hi yig nag po bya ba grub pa'i ye shes| dbyangs rnams kyi thig le/ gsal byed rnams kyi rnam bcad/ rnam shes gzhom med kyi ha yig sog gi a yig rnams gcig tu 'dres pas haṃ 'grub pa bzhin du/ ye shes snga ma bzhi gcig tu gyur pa las sku'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs shing rnam shes haṃ yig dang ldan pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ dbus sngo g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag po drag cing mche ba brtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas shing g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas spras shing rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ rdo rje nor bu dang rdo rje rna rgyan dang rdo rje mgul rgyan dang rdo rje gdu bu dang rdo rje ske regs dang rdo rje rkang gdub dang rdo rje dar dpyangs dang rdo rje phreng bas mdzes shing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/

g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po gnyis sngon po/ gnyis pa gnyis dmar po/ gsum pa gnyis dkar po ste phrag pa drug dang ldan zhing phrag pa re re yang rang dang kha dog mtshungs pa'i dpung pa gnyis gnyis kyis mdzes pa/ dbung pa re re yang rang dang kha dog mtshungs pa'i phyag gnyis gnyis ste phyag nyi shu rtsa gzhi dang ldan pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po gung mo dmar po ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ ser mo rnams kyi tshigs phreng dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste sor gdub rnams kyis mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba| g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje/ gnyis par ral gri/ gsum par rtse gsum/ bzhi par gri gug dmar po bzhi'i dang por me'i mda'/ gnyis par rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ bzhi par tho ba| dkar po bzhi'i dang por 'khor lo/ gnyis par mdung*/ gsum par rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ bzhi par dgra sta'o/ /g.yon gyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje'i dril bu/ gnyis par phub/ gsum par khaṭūṃ ga rnam par rgyas pa/ bzhi par khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gsum par rin po che/ bzhi par pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por dung*/ gnyis par me long*/ gsum par rdo rje'i lcags sgrog bzhi par tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas spras pa 'dzin pa/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa dmar po'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig lag pa bzhi pa lag na me tog gi mda' lnga dang gzhu dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dkar po'i 'og tu drag po dkar po gdong gcig mig gsum lag pa bzhi pa lag na rtse gsum dang ḍa ma ru dang*/ thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa mnan pa/ bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dga' ma dang dbu mas zhabs kyi mthil nas 'dzin cing gdong dman par byed bzhin pa/

de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog g.yas bskor gyis ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi re re yang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug dang lcags kyu dang sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa dang zhags pa dang pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgya ba dang rin po che bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la nag mo 'bar ma nag mo nag dmar ser dkar pa'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yas ni spos dang tsan+da dang gur gum dang ga bur dang gla rtsi sbyar ba'i snod/ g.yon na dril bu ba dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ lha shing gi me tog dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho'i 'dab ma la dmar mo 'bar ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yas na mar me dang do shal dang cod pan dang gdu bu/ g.yon na gos dang ske rags dang rna rgyan dang rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang gi 'dab ma la dkar mo 'bar ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yas na 'o ma dang chu mchog dang sman dang chang gi snod/ g.yon na bdud rtsi dang grub pa'i ro dang*/ bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang zan gyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub kyi 'dab ma la ser mo 'bar ma ser mo ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yas na dung dang gling bu dang nor bu dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon na pi waṃ dang rnga dang*/ sgra sgrogs pa'i 'khar ba dang zangs dung 'dzin pa/ mer du ba ma nag mo nag dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyis rnga yab nag po brgyad g.yob pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ bden bral du smig sgyu ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyis rnga yab dmar po brgyad/ dbang ldan du mkha' snang ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ser ba'i

sogs| rnga yab dkar po brgyad/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo ser dkar sngo dmar sogs/ rnga yab ser po brgyad/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zur bzhi'i dbang ldan du chos kyi dung dkar po bden bral du chos kyi gaṇ+ḍe dmar po/ me ru nor bu nag po/ rlung du dpag bsam gyi shing ser po'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi 'jig rten dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin du dga' ba'i sgra yis mi bskyod pa la sogs pa phung po dang khams dang dbang po dang yul gyi rang bzhin lha'i ngo bor snang ba rnams bkug ste rang gi lus la zhugs/ slar yang lha'i tshogs de dag rang gi lus la spros nas yum gyi lus kyi nang du zhugs/ de las kyang 'phros te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pa chags pa chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le rnams yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gsal la rdzogs par gyur te pad+ma nas spros pa rang rang gi gnas su 'god pa ni/ a ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i mi bskyod pa dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa la āḥ.aṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i sher phyin ma dang rdor sems sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i ces sogs snga ma lta bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa spros te rim pa bzhin du rang dang sna tshogs yum la thim/ i ī dang ral gri las skyes pa'i don grub dang sgrol ma nag mo nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug rtse gsum/

g.yon gsum phub dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa la spyan ma dang rnam snang gis 'khyud pa spros ste/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i shar dang shar lhor 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ṛ ṝ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i rin 'byung dang gos dkar mo dmar mo gong gi rigs drug 'god pa'i skabs kyi rin 'byung lta bu la mā ma kī dang 'od dpag med kyis 'khyud pa spros te lho dang lho nub du 'khod/ u ū dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i 'od dpag med dang mā ma ki dkar mo gong gi 'od dpag med lta bu la gos dkar mo dang rin 'byung gis 'khyud pa spros te byang dang byang shar du 'khod/ l̥ l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i rnam snang dang spyan ma ser mo gong gi rnam snang lta bu la sgrol ma dang don grub kyis 'khyud pa spros te nub dang nub byang du 'khod/ hi hī las skyes shing rkang rnam par dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros te don grub kyi g.yon dang g.yas kyi ling tsher 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ hṛ hṝ las khrag dag pa gnyis rin 'byung gi dang*/ hu hū las dri chu dag pa gnyis snang mtha'i dang*/ hl̥ hl̥̄ las dri chen dag rnam snang gi g.yon g.yas kyi ling cher 'khod/ haṃ haḥlas skyes shing khu ba dang rdul rnam par dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros te steng dang 'og tu 'khod/ bum pa de rnams rang rang gi phyogs kyi mdog can pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa'o| |yaṃ dang ral gri las skyes pa'i bgegs mthar byed bsrung 'khor gyi lta bu la| lāḥdang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i rengs byed ma rnam snang lta bus 'khyud pa spros te thugs 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod/ raṃ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i shes rab mthar byed sngar ltar la/ wāḥdang pad+ma las skyes pa'i khengs byed ma snang mtha' lta bus 'khyud pa spros te lho sgor 'khod/ waṃ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i pad+ma mthar byed sngar ltar la/
