rāḥdang rin po che las skyes pa'i rmugs byed ma rin 'byung lta bus 'khyud pa spros te byang sgor 'khod/ lam dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i gshin rje mthar byed sngar ltar la/ yāḥdang ral gri las skyes pa'i rab brtson ma don grub lta bus 'khyud pa spros te nub sgor 'khod/ haṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtsug gtor can sngar ltar la/ hāḥdang rdo rje las skyes pa'i shin du sngon mo rdor sems lta bus 'khyud pa spros te steng du 'khod/ khro bo khro mo thams cad kyang dbus skra dmar ser ces pa nas gtsigs pa/ khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la khro mo rnams g.yon brkyang gis 'khyud pa'o| |e ai dang ral gri las skyes pa'i nam snying dang reg bya rdo rje ma don grub lta bu la dri rdo rje ma dang sgrib sel gyis 'khyud pa spros te thugs 'khor lha snam gyi shar sgo'i g.yas dang shar lhor 'khod/ ar ār dang rin po che las skyes pa'i sa snying dang rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la gzugs rdo rje ma dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'khyud pa spros te lho sgo'i g.yas dang lho nub du 'khod/ o au dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gzugs rdo rje ma snang mtha' lta bu la ro rdo rje ma dang sa snying gis 'khyud pa spros te byang sgo'i g.yas dang byang shar du 'khod/ al āl dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i sgrib sel dang dri rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu reg bya rdo rje ma dang nam snying gis 'khyud pa spros te nub sgo'i g.yas dang nub byang du 'khod/ a ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i phyag rdor dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma ljang khu mi bskyod pa lta bu la sgra rdo rje ma dang kun bzang gis 'khyud pa spros te lho sgā+o'i g.yon dang nub sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/ aṃ āḥs rdo rje las skyes pa'i kun bzang dang sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo rdor sems lta bu la chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang phyag rdor gyis 'khyud pa spros te shar sgo'i g.yon dang byang sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/

don grub las sogs pa'i lha zhi ba thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ yab thams cad rdo rje'i 'dug stangs dang yum thams cad pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis phan tshan du 'khyud pa/ gshegs pa rnams dang sems dpa' rnams dang lho sgo dang nub sgo'i khro bo rnams pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas shing gshegs ma rnams dang sems ma rnams dang shar dang byang dang steng gi khro bo rnams pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gsung 'khor gyi lha snam la srog chags so so'i steng du rnal 'byor ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis spro ba ni/ ha dang gri gug las skyes pa'i tsartsi ka la l̥ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dbang po ser po g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang me'i mda' g.yon gnyis dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa dang*/ hi yi yi y-i hī yu+u yaṃ rnams dang gri gug rnams las skyes pa'i 'jigs ma dang drag mo dang dus kyi mche ba ma dang me 'bar gdong ma dang rlung shugs ma dang rab gtum ma dang drag spyan ma dang sna chen ma ste/ gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa rnams spros te gsung 'khor lha snam gyi shar du yi dwags dmar po'i steng du pad+ma dmar po'i lte ba la gtso bo yab yum dang 'dab ma brgyad la 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis 'khod| lte ba la man chod ces pa kun la 'dre/ k+ṣa dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i khyab 'jug ma la l̥̄ dang khab las skyes pa'i tshangs pa ser po nas bsrung 'khor lta bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa dang*/ k+ṣi yā yī yā+-i k+ṣī yū yāḥ rnams dang 'khor lo rnams las skyes pa'i g.yang mo dang sgyu ma dang grags mo dang dpal mo dang rnam par rgyal ma dang dpal rgyal ma dang rgyal byed ma dang dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma ste/

gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang be con g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang dung 'dzin pa rnams spros ste mer mkha' lding gi steng du pad+ma dkar po sogs/ haḥdang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i phag mo la u dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i drag po bsrung 'khor gyi lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ hṛ ra ri ṛ hṝ ru rl̥ ṛ rnams dang dbyug pa rnams las skyes pa'i keng rus ma dang dus mtshan ma dang rab tu khros gdong ma dang dus lce ma dang gtsigs ma dang nag mo dang 'jigs rung ma dang gzugs ngan ma ste gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis lcags sgrog dang phub 'dzin pa rnams spros te lhor ma he'i steng du pad+ma dmar po'i sogs/ k+ṣaḥdang mdung thung las skyes pa'i gzhon nu ma la/ ū dang dgra sta las skyes pa'i tshogs bdag dkar po g.yas gnyis dgra sta dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang rin po che 'dzin pas 'khyud pa dang*/ k+ṣ-i rā rī

ṝ k+ṣṝ rū rl̥̄ rāḥrnams dang mdung thung rnams las skyes pa'i pad+ma dang lus med ma dang gzhon nu ma dang ri dgas bdag pos 'gro ma dang rin chen phreng ba ma dang*/ mig bzang ma dang rul ma dang bzang mo ste/ gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo zhal drug phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mdung thung dang lcags kyu g.yon gnyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa rnams spros te bden bral du rma bya'i steng du pad+ma dkar po'i sogs so/ /haṃ dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i drag mo la ṛ dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i gshin rje dmar po srung 'khor gyi lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ hu wa wi hū wu waṃ rnams dang rtse gsum rnams las skyes pa'i gau rī ma dang gang gā ma dang rtag ma dang myur ma dang to tā lā dang mtshon byed ma dang dmar ser ma dang nag mo ste gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rtse gsum dang ḍa ma ru g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+waṃ gdang sbrul 'dzin pa rnams spros te byang du khyu mchog gi steng du pad+ma dmar po'i sogs so/ /k+ṣaṃ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i dpal chen mo la ṝ dang mdung las skyes pa'i gdong drug dmar po zhal drug pa g.yas gnyis shak+ti dang mdung g.yon gnyis rin po che dang me long 'dzin pas 'khyud pa dang*/ k+ṣu wā wī k+ṣū wū wāḥrnams dang pad+ma rnams las skyes pa'i dpal ldan dkar mo dang zla ba'i ri mo dang ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdong ma dang dang pa'i mdog ma dang 'dzin ma dang pad+ma'i dbang mo dang dkar mig ma dang dri med ri bong 'dzin ma ste gtso 'khor dgu pa thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang bgrang phreng g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa rnams spros te dbang ldan du seng ge'i steng du pad+ma dkar po'i sogs so/ /ha dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dbang mo la i dang ral gri las skyes pa'i bden bral bsrung 'khor gyi lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/

hl̥ la li hwā+-ilu ll̥ laṃ rnams dang rdo rje rnams las skyes pa'i rdo rje 'od ma dang rdo rje lus ma dang gser ldan ma dang*/ urba sī dang*/ bkra ba'i ri mo dang*/ ram+bha dang zug rngu med ma dang*/ shin du sgrol ma ste gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mda' g.yon gnyis dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa rnams spros te nub du glang po che'i steng du pad+ma dmar po'i sogs so/ /k+ṣā dang snod las skyes pa'i tshangs ma la ī dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i khyab 'jug nag po bsrung 'khor gyi lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ k+ṣl̥ lā lī k+ṣl̥ lū ll̥̄ lāḥ rnams dang snod rnams las skyes pa'i sā wi tri dang*/ pad ma'i mig dang chus skyes can ma dang*/ blo ma dang ngag gi dbang phyug ma dang*/ gā ya trī dang*/ klog ma dang*/ dran ma ste/ gtso 'khor dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog ser mo zhal bzhi phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang tshangs dbyug g.yon gnyis spyi blugs dang snod 'dzin pa rnams spros te rlung du ngang pa'i steng du pad+ma dkar po'i lte ba la gtso mo yab yum dang 'dab ma brgyad la 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad sogs so/ /gtso mo rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la mngon du phyogs par yab yum gnyis ka sa ka'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso mo la mngon du phyogs par rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /sku 'khor lha snam gyi sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon dang mtshams bzhir srog chags so so'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma gsum rim zlum skor dang po la bzhi/ bar pa la brgyad/ tha ma la bcu drug ste 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa rnams kyi steng du lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa sgo ba ni/ tsan dang ral gri las skyes pa'i bden bral la dzṛ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i srin mo'i ming can gyi dbang mos 'khyud pa dang*/

nya nyi ny-i nyu dang nyaṃ/ dzha dzhi dzh-i dzhu dzh-i rnams dang*/ dza dzi dzū dzaṃ/ tsha tshi tshu tshaṃ/ tsa tsi tsu rnams dang ral gri rnams las skyes pa'i nya rdo rje ma dang nyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje ma dang nyu rdo rje ma la sogs pa nag pa zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams te gtso 'khor nyer dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis ral gri dang gri gug g.yon gnyis phub dang thod pa 'dzin pa rnams spros te shar sgo'i g.yas su yi dwags dmar po'i steng du pad+ma dmar po'i lte ba la gtso bo yab yum dang 'dab ma gsum rim rnams la 'khor gyi lha mo rnams rim pa bzhin du 'khod/ lte ba la ces pa man chad kun la sbyar/ nyaḥdang dpag bsam gyi shing las skyes pa'i rlung lha la dz+ṝ dang snod las skyes pa'i rab gtum ma'i ming can gyi tshangs mas 'khyud pa dang*/ tsā tsī tsū dang*/ tsāḥtshā tshī tshū rnams dang*/ dzā dzī dzū dzaḥ dzhā dzhīṃ dzhū dzhaḥ nyā nyī nyū / rnams dang dpag bsam gyi shing rnams las skyes pa'i tsā rdo rje dang tsī rdo rje ma las sogs pa bzhi bzhi ngag tu brjod la/ la sogs pa sa ga zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams te/ gtso 'khor nyer dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du'i me tog g.yon gnyis dbang po sngon po dang ud pal 'dzin pa rnams spros te mer ri dwags kyi steng du pad+ma dkar po'i sogs so/ /de bzhin du kun la ngag 'don sbyar la/ ṭaṃ dang shak+ti las skyes pa'i me lha la ḍ-i dang zhags pa las skyes pa'i chu lha mo dkar mo rgya mtsho lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ ṇa ṇi ṇā+-i ṇu dang*/ ces sogs sbyar te/ rnams dang shak+ti rnams las skyes pa'i ṇa rdo rje ma las sogs pa snron gyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi shak+ti dang dbyug pa pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa lho sgo'i g.yas su lug gi'o

/ / ṇaḥdang mdung las skyes pa'i gdong drug la dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i dpal mos 'khyud pa dang*/ ṭā ṭī nas/ rnams dang mdung rnams las skyes pa'i ṭā rdo rje ma las sogs pa chu stod kyi rnams dmar po zhal drug phyag bzhi'i shak+ti dang mdung*/ rin po che dang me long 'dzin pa srin por rma bya'i 'o/ /paṃ dang zhags pa las skyes pa'i rgya mtsho la/ bṛ dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i phag mos 'khyud pa dang*/ ma mi nas pl̥ rnams dang zhags pa rnams las skyes pa'i ma rdo rje ma rdo rje ma las sogs gro zhun gyi rnams dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhags pa dang rin po che sbrul zhags dang chu shel 'dzin pa byang sgo'i g.yas su chu srin gyi'o/ /maḥdang dgra sta las skyes pa'i tshogs bdag la bṝ dang mdung thung las skyes pa'i gzhon nu mas 'khyud pa dang*/ pā pī nas ml̥̄ rnams dang dgras sta rnams las skyes pa'i pā rdo rje ma la sogs pa khrums kyi rnams dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi dgra sta dang rdo rje/ zhags pa dang rin po che 'dzin pa dbang ldan du byi ba'i 'o/ /taṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dbang mo la dṛ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i rlung lha mo'i ming can gyi tsartsi kās 'khyud pa dang*/ na ni nas rnams dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i na rdo rje ma la sogs pa tha skar gyi rnams ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdo rje dang me'i mnga'/ dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa nub sgo'i g.yas su glang po che'i'o/ /naḥ dang khab las skyes pa'i tshangs pa la dṝ dang dpag bsam gyi shing las skyes pa'i klog ma rlung lha lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ tā tī/ nas/ nl̥̄ rnams dang khab rnams las skyes pa'i tā rdo rje ma la sogs pa smin drug gi rnams ser po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi khab dang*/ bgrang phreng pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa rlung du ngang pa'i 'o/ /saṃ dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i drag po la dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i ri sras ma ljang khu gshin rje lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/

ྈྐ ྈྐི*/ nas| sl̥ rnams dang rtse gsum rnams las skyes pa'i ṅka rdo rje ma la sogs pa mgo rnams sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi rtse gsum dang mda'/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / gzhu 'dzin pa byang sgo'i g.yon du khyu mchog gi'o| |ྈྐ ཿdang be con las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin la/ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i nor dbang ma ljang khu khyab 'jug lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ sā sī nas/ rnams dang be con rnams las skyes pa'i sā rdo rje ma la sogs pa rgyal gyi rnams sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi nor bu dang be con/ ne'u le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa| nub sgo'i g.yon du glang po che'i 'o/ /kaṃ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i khyab 'jug la gṛ dang be con las skyes pa'i dpal mo gnod sbyin lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ nga ngi*/ nas k+ṣ-i rnams dang 'khor lo rnams las skyes pa'i nga rdo rje ma las sogs pa mchu'i rnams ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'khor lo dang dbyug tho/ pad+ma dang skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du mkha' lding gi'o/ /ngaḥdang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i gshin rje la/ gṛ dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i gshin rje ma drag po lta bus 'khyud pa dang*/ kā kī kṝ kū dang*/ kl̥̄ kaḥ khā khī khṝ khrū khl̥̄ khaḥrnams dang*/ gā gī gū gl̥̄ gaḥ ghā ghī gh+ṝ ghū ghl̥ ghaḥ ngā ngī ngā+-i ngū ngā+-i rnams dang dbyug pa rnams las skyes pa'i kā rdo rje ma dang kī rdo rje ma dang kṝ rdo rje ma dang*/ klu rdo rje ma las sogs pa dbo'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams te gtso 'khor nyer dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis/ lcags sgrog dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa rnams spros te lho sgo'i g.yon du ma he'i steng du pad+ma dmar po'i lte ba la gtso bo yab yum dang 'dab ma gsum rim rnams la 'khor gyi lha mo rnams rim pa bzhin 'khod/

gtso bo rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po la mngon du phyogs par rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la yum rnams pad+ma'i gdan gyis 'khyud cing 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso bo la mngon du phyogs par rol pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyas pa la spro na yum rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan yang ngag tu brjod cing 'khor rnams kyang rang rang gi sa bon gyi yi ge re re bzhin rdo rje ma sbyar nas ngag du 'don ni| |bsdus par byed na lha mo bzhi bzhi yang mi rjod par nya rdo rje ma las sogs pa zhes sbyar ro/ /ya dang ral gri las skyes pa'i dbyug sngon can nag po g.yas gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa la/ lha dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i 'od zer can ser mo g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis dung dang rin po che 'dzin pas 'khyud pa spros te shar sgor phag nag po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du 'khod/ ra dang mnga' las skyes pa'i 'dod rgyal dmar po g.yas gnyis mda' dang lcags kyu g.yon gnyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa la wā dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i tsun da dkar mo g.yas gnyis tho ba dang mdung g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang me long 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ spros te lho sgor rta dmar ba bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du 'khod/ wa dang tho ba las skyes pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po tsun da lta bu la rā dang mda' las skyes pa'i khro gnyer can dmar mo 'dod rgyal lta bus 'khyud pa spros te byang sgor seng ge dkar po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rtā'i steng du 'khod/ la dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i stobs po che ser po 'od zer can lta bu la ya dang ral gri las skyes pa'i lcags sgrog ma nag mo dbyug sngon can lta bus 'khyud pa spros ste nub sgor glang chen ser po bdun gyi sogs/

haṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtsug gtor can ljang khu g.yas gnyis gra sta dang rdo rje g.yon gnyis sbrul zhags dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ haḥdang gri gug las skyes pa'i shin du sngon mo g.yas gnyis gri gug dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa spros zhe steng du mkha' lding a ni las drangs pa'i sogs so/ /ha dang gri gug las skyes pa'i gnod mdzes shin du sngon mo lta bu la hā dang dgra sta las skyes pa'i drag can ma gtsug tor can lta bus 'khyud pa spros te 'og du seng ge rkang pa brgyad pas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du 'khod/ khro bo khro mo thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar ser ces sogs thugs dkyil bzhin brjod do/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du rta babs bzhi'i ka ba brgyad kyi 'og du klu rnams spro ba ni/ h+ya h+yā dang rgyal mtshan las skyes pa'i stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag po la dang dang gri gug las skyes pa'i lce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong ma ser mos 'khyud pa spros te shar gyi g.yon dang g.yas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ hra hrā dang bkra shis las skyes pa'i nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la/ dang dang gri gug las skyesapa'i stag gdong ma dang*/'ug gdong ma dkar mos 'khyud pa spros te lho'i g.yon dang g.yas su me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ིཾེཾྀཾིཾ ིྉྥhūm̐rྈྐིཾོིཽ|ྀhūm̐bdhī?¿ts|9 dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po la dang dang gri gug las skyes pa'i phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong ma dmar mos 'khyud pa spros te byang gi g.yon dang g.yas su chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ha hā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i 'jog po dang bde chen ser po la dang dang gri gug las skyes pa'i khyi gdong ma dang bya rog gdong ma nag mos 'khyud pa spros te nub kyi g.yon dang g.yas su sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/

huṃ k+ṣuṃ dang rdo rje'am bum pa las skyes pa'i rgyal ba ljang khu dang rnam rgyal sngon po gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa la haḥhrā dang gri gug las skyes pa'i rdo rje mig la sngon mo dang*/ sngon mo ljang khus 'khyud pa spros te steng dang 'og du nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ stobs rgyu las sogs pa brgyad gdengs ka lnga lnga dang ldan zhing thams cad kyang zhal gcig sogs bsrung 'khor lta bu/ rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la yum rnams pad+ma'i gdan gyis 'khyud pa'o/ /me rlung khor yug gi mtshams kyi dur khrod brgyad du rab gtum ma rnams spro ba ni| dang dang gri gug las skyes pa'i khyi gdong ma dang bya rog gdong ma nag mo la h+la h+lā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i 'jog po dang be chen ser pos 'khyud pa spros te / shar du rtse mos 'bigs pa'i dur khrod du bse'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po dang mer lhag ma za ba'i dur khrod du/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khod/ de bzhin du klu'i skabs kyi yab yum go bzlog pa'i 'don pa spos la phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong ma gnyis lhor ro bsreg pa'i dur khrod du dom gyi steng du 'khor lo dmar po dang bden bral du mi zad pa g.yul gyi dur khrod du khrung khrung gi steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khod/ stag gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma gnyis byang du rul ba dang bcas pa'i dur khrod du 'bri'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po dang dbang ldan du byis pa shi ba'i dur khrod du bshang gdong gi steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khod/ lce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong ma gnyis nub du rnag gi dri'i dur khrod du seng ge'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po dang*/ rlung du sbrul gyis zos pa'i dur khrod du mig sngon gyi steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khod/
sngon mo dang rdo rje mig ma gnyis rnam rgyal dang rgyal bas 'khyud pa steng du mkha' lding a nī la dang 'og du seng ge rkang pa brgyad pas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du 'khod/

yum thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa sogs bsrung 'khor bzhin brjod nas/ yab yum thams cad zlum pa'i stabs kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa'o| |dur khrod kyi phyi rol rlung gi khor yug la 'jig rten ba'i rnam par snang ba'i lha rnams yum gyi pad+ma nas rgyas par spro ba ni/ rtsa gsum/ ral gri las skyes pa'i/ zla nyi nag po ral phub 'dzin/ /bum mam rin chen la skyes pa'i| |lhag pa bkra shis dmar po ni/ /rin chen ḍa ma ru yis spras/ / shuṃ brim pad+ma las skyes pa'i/ /pa sangs phur bu dkar po ni/ /phyag gnyis tho ba pad+mas brgyan/ /kaṃ shaṃ 'khor lo las skyes pa'i/ /spen pa mjug ring ser po ni/ /phyag gnyis 'khor lo dung gi brgyan/ /raṃ kaṃ rdo rje las skyes pa'i| |sgra gcan ljang la dus me sngo/ /rdor dril 'dzin pa rnams spros te/ /rim bzhin shar lho byang nub dang*/ /steng dang 'og du 'khod par gyur/ /bh+ruṃ aṃ rdo rje las skyes pa'i/ /brtan pa ljang la ri byi sngo/ /rdor dril 'dzin spros steng 'og 'khod| |kaṃ raṃ mriṃ aṃ puṃ puṃ aṃ/ /rnams dang lag pa bdun rnams las/ /smin drug sngo sangs snar ma ni/ /dmar skya mgo dang lag dang ni/ /nam so ser mo rgyal sngo sangs/ /skag ni dkar mo rnams spros te/ /shar gyi phyogs su rim bzhin 'khod/ /maṃ puṃ uṃ hi tsiṃ saṃ beṃ/ /rnams dang lag pa bdun rnams las| |skyes pa'i mchu ser gre ljang ser/ /dbo ljang me bzhi dkar mo dang*/ / nag pa ljang khu sa ri ser/ /sa ga nag mo rnams spros te/ /lho yi phyogs su rim bzhin 'khod/ /aṃ dzeṃ muṃ puṃ uṃ shaṃ aṃ/ /rnams dang lag pa bdun rnams las| |skyes pa'i lha mtshams ljang khu dang*/ /smron dang snubs ser chu stod smad| |nag dkar gro zhun dkar ser dang*/ /byi bzhin sngo sangs rnams spros te| |nub kyi phyogs su rim bzhin 'khod/ /dhaṃ shaṃ puṃ uṃ reṃ aṃ bhaṃ/

/rnams dang lag pa bdun rnams las/ /mon gre nag mo mon gru ser/ khrums stod ljang khu khrums smad ser/ /nam gru dkar ser tha skar dkar/ /bra nye ljang khu rnams spros tai| |byang gi phyogs su rim bzhin 'khod/ /kun kyang lag gnyis thal sbyer zhing*| |lha mo stod g.yogs g.yo ba'o/ /beṃ duṃ pad+ma las skyes pa'i/ /lug dang bu mo dkar po gnyis/ /pad+ma tho ba 'dzin spros te/ /shar nub gnyis kyi byang du 'khod| |nyaṃ tuṃ rin chen las skyes pa'i/ /nya dang srang ni dmar po gnyis| |rin chen cang te 'dzin spros te/ /shar nub gnyis kyi lho ru 'khod/ /meṃ kaṃ gri gug las skyes pa'i/ /'khrig pa karka ṭa ga gnyis po/ /sngon po gri thod 'dzin spros te/ /byang gi shar dang nub tu 'khod//aṃ siṃ 'khor lo las skyes pa'i/ /glang dang seng ge ser po gnyis/ /'khor lo dang ni dung 'dzin te/ /dbang ldan dang ni rlung du 'khod/ /maṃ dhaṃ rdo rje las skyes pa'i/ /chu srin dang ni gzhu gnyis po/ / ljang khu rdor dril 'dzin spros te/ /lho yi shar dang nub tu 'khod/ /kaṃ kaṃ ral gri las skyes pa'i/ /bum pa sdig pa nag po gnyis/ /ral phub 'dzin pa legs spros te/ /me dang bden bral 'tshams su 'khod/ /a i ṛ u l̥ rnams dang*/ / a e ar o al dang ni/ /ha ya ra wa la rnams kyi/ /lnga pa'i dang po gsum rnams dang*/ /rdo rje rnams las skyes pa yi/ /tshes gcig tshes drug bcu gcig rnams/ /ljang khu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /gnyis pa gsum dang ral gri las/ /tshes gnyis tshes bdun bcu gnyis rnams/ /nag po ral gri phub kyis brgyan//gsum pa gsum dang rin chen las/ tshes gsum tshes brgyad bcu gsum rnams/ /dmar po rin chen cang te 'dzin/ /bzhi pa gsum dang pad+ma las| |tshes bzhi tshes dgu bcu bzhi rnams/ /dkar po tho ba pad+ma 'dzin/ /lnga pa gsum dang 'khor lo las/ /tshes lnga tshes bcu bco lnga rnams/ /ser po 'khor lo dung gis brgyan/

/aṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i/ /bcu drug sngon po gri thod 'dzin/ /de rnams legs spros steng dang ni/ /shar lho byang nub gsum gsum dang*/ /bcu drug cha ni 'og du 'khod/ /iṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i||dbang po nag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /aṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i/ /me lha nag po bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /yaṃ raṃ be con ral gri las/ /gshin rje bden bral dmar po ni/ /rim bzhin be con ral gri 'dzin/ /yaṃ iṃ ne le rtse gsum las| |gnod sbyin dbang ldan dkar po ni/ /rim bzhin ne le rtse gsum 'dzin/ /waṃ waṃ sbrul zhags ba dan las/ /chu lha rlung lha ser po ni/ /rim bzhin sbrul zhags ba dan 'dzin/ /spros te shar lho byang nub ni/ /rang gi mtshams dang bcas par 'khod/ /braṃ priṃ 'khor lo bum pa las| |tshangs pa ljang khu sa lha sngo/ /rim bzhin 'khor lo bum pa can/ /spros te steng dang 'og du 'khod/ /naṃ dang ṭā rnga las skyes pa'i/ /dga' byed dbang phyug nag po ni/ /rdza rnga zhon nas rdza rnga brdung*/ /maṃ dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i/ / nag po chen po mdog nag po/ /rtse gsum dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /ghaṃ dang dril bu las skyes pa'i/ /dril bu'i rna ba dril bu 'dzin/ /bh+riṃ dang phreng ba las skyes pa'i| |bh+riṃ gi ri ti mdog nag po/ /thal sbyar phreng ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /spros te phyogs bzhir rim bzhin 'khod/ /k+ṣeṃ dang thod pa las skyes pa'i/ /zhing skyong rnams ni mtha' yas shing*/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan mtha' yas pa'o/ /duṃ dang 'od ma'i lcug ma las/ /pho nya rnams kyang mtha' yas shing*/ /haṃ dang zan changs las skyes pa'i/ /'phrog ma ser mo zan changs 'dzin/ /bu dang bcas pa rnams dang ni/ /ral gri mig sman las sogs pa'i/ /grub chen brnyes pa thams cad dang*/ /ska dang ba spu rnam dag pa'i/ /'byung po bye ba phyed dang bzhi/ kha dog sna tshogs phyag mtshan yang*/ /sna tshogs 'dzin pa thams cad kyang*/

/yum gyi pad+ma nas spros te/ /ji ltar rig pa'i gnas su ni/ /lha rnams rdo rje'i 'dug stangs dang*| |lha mo rol ba'i stabs kyis 'khod/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o| |bsdus par byed na skyed chog med pa'i zhal phyag tsam gyi ngag 'don kho bos byas pa'i chos rje bu ston gyi mngon rtogs lhan thabs bzhin brjod/ shin du bsdu na/ gzhan yang gza' bcu dang brtan pa dang ri byi dang rgyu skar thams cad dang khyim bcu gnyis dang cha bcu drug dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ dril bu'i rna ba can dang bh+riṃ gi ṇa dang*/ zhing skyong thams cad dang*/ pho nya mo rnams dang*/ 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*/ grub pa thams cad dang*/ /skra dang ba spu rnam par dag pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rnams kyang yum gyi pad+ma nas spros te dur khrod kyi phyi rol du rlung gi khor yug la lha rnams rdo rje'i 'dug stangs dang lha mo rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis 'khod do/ /thugs 'khor gyi 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lta mo gzungs ma dang bcas pa spro ba ni/ dang dang dri'i dung chos dang me tog gi phreng ba las skyes pa'i dri chab ma dang phreng ba ma nag mo dri'i dung chos dang me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa spros te thugs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dod yon snam bu la shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su 'khod/ de bzhin du sa bon so so'i rjes la rang gi phyag mtshan 'jug pa ma gtogs gong gi ji lta ba bzhin brjod nas/ gnyis tshan rim pa bzhin du lho dang byang dang nub sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su 'khod ces dang*/steng du 'khod/ 'og tu 'khod ces brjod do/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha mo dang gzungs ma'i tshogs du ma spros te 'dod yon snam bu la 'khod par gyur/ gsung 'khor gyi 'dod snam la 'dod ma so drug dang sku 'khor gyi 'dod snam la phyir 'dod ma so drug spro ba ni/

tsaḥtsaṃ dang ral gri gnyis dang sgrol ma gnyis las skyes pa'i dbye 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis sgrol ma lta bu dang*/ tshaḥtshaṃ dang ral gri gnyis dang reg bya rdo rje ma gnyis las skyes pa'i gos 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis reg bya rdo rje ma lta bu dang*/ dzaḥdzaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang tsartsi ka gnyis las skyes pa'i lus la 'phrug par 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis tsartsi ka lta bu dang*/ dzhaḥdzhaṃ dang 'khor lo gnyis dang khyab 'jug ma gnyis las skyes pa'i 'chil ma 'dod par 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis khyab 'jug ma lta bu dang*/ nyaḥnyaṃ dang ral gri gnyis dang rab brtson ma gnyis las skyes pa'i skrod par 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis rab brtson ma lta bu rnams spros te 'khor lo gnyis kyi 'dod yon snam bu la shar sgo'i g.yas nas me mtshams kyi bar du rim pa bzhin du 'khod/ de bzhin du ngag 'don sbyar la/ ྈྐཿྈྐཾ dang gri gug gnyis dang shin du sngon mo gnyis las skyes pa'i kun du gdung 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis de lta bu dang*/ shaḥshaṃ dang ral gri gnyis dang lcags sgrog ma gnyis las skyes pa'i reg 'dod ma sogs dang*/ ṣaḥṣaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang khyi gdong ma/ gnyis las skyes pa'i yan lag kun bskyod par 'dod ma sogs dang*/ ྉྤཿྉྤཾ dang gri gug gnyis dang bya rog gdong ma gnyis las skyes pa'i lhag ma za 'dod ma sogs spros te g.yon nas dbang ldan gyi bar la rim pa bzhin du 'khod/ ṭaḥṭaṃ dang rin po che gnyis dang gos dkar mo gnyis las skyes pa'i skyod par 'dod ma sogs dang*/ ṭhaḥṭhaṃ dang rin po che gnyis dang ro rdo rje ma gnyis las skyes pa'i zas 'dod ma sogs dang*/ ḍaḥḍaṃ dang dbyug pa gnyis dang phag mo gnyis las skyes pa'i dri ma 'dod ma sogs dang*/ ḍhaḥḍhaṃ dang mdung thung gnyis dang gzhon nu ma gnyis las skyes pa'i gar 'dod ma sogs dang*/

ṇaḥṇaṃ dang rin po che gnyis dang rmugs byed ma gnyis las skems 'dod ma sogs spros te lho sgo'i g.yas nas bden bral gyi bar la rim pa bzhin du 'khod/ ngaḥngaṃ dang dgra sta gnyis dang drag spyan ma gnyis las rgyug 'dod ma sogs dang*/ ghaḥghaṃ dang mda' gnyis dang khro gnyer can ma gnyis las 'gugs 'dod ma sogs dang*/ gaḥgaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang phag gdong ma gnyis las bshang gci zag par 'dod ma sogs dang*/ khaḥkhaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang bya rgod gdong ma gnyis las g.yul ngo 'dod ma sogs spros te g.yon nas me mtshams kyi bar la sogs so/ /paḥpaṃ dang pad+ma gnyis dang mā ma kī gnyis las rgyas 'dod ma sogs dang*/ phaḥphaṃ dang pad+ma gnyis dang gzugs rdo rje ma gnyis las rgyan 'dod ma sogs dang*/ baḥbaṃ dang rtse gsum gnyis dang drag mo gnyis las stan 'dod ma sogs dang*/ bhaḥbhaṃ dang pad+ma gnyis dang dpal mo gnyis las rgyal srid 'dod ma sogs dang*/ maḥmaṃ dang pad+ma gnyis dang nga rgyal ma gnyis las 'jam por smra 'dod ma sogs spros te byang sgo'i g.yas nas dbang ldan sogs so/ /haḥhaṃ dang rdo rje gnyis dang sgra rdo rje ma gnyis las rol mo 'dod ma sogs dang*/ yaḥyaṃ dang tho ba gnyis dang tsun da gnyis las 'ching 'dod ma sogs dang*/ raḥraṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang stag gdong ma gnyis las rtsod pa mang po 'dod ma sogs dang*/ waḥwaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang 'ug gdong ma gnyis las byis pa khro bar 'dod ma sogs spros te g.yon nas rlung gi bar sogs so/ /taḥtaṃ dang 'khor lo gnyis dang spyan ma gnyis las rengs 'dod ma sogs dang*/ thaḥthaṃ dang 'khor lo gnyis dang dri rdo rje ma gnyis las dri 'dod ma sogs dang*/ daḥdaṃ dang rdo rje gnyis dang dbang mo gnyis las mal stan la mnye bar 'dod ma dang de'i sogs dang*/ dhaḥdhaṃ dang snong gnyis dang tshangs ma gnyis las chu la rkyal 'dod ma sogs dang*/ naḥnaṃ dang 'khor lo gnyis dang rengs byed ma gnyis las smyan 'dod ma sogs spros te nub sgo'i g.yas nas rlung gi bar du rim pa bzhin 'khod/

k+ṣaḥk+ṣaṃ dang rdo rje gnyis dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma gnyis las skyes pa'i 'khrig 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis chos dbyings rdo rje ma lta bu dang*/ saḥsaṃ dang 'khor lo gnyis dang 'od zer can ma gnyis las skyes pi phur bu 'debs par 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis 'od zer can ma lta bu dang*/ kaḥkaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang lce spyang gdong ma gnyis las skyes pa'i sems can slu bar 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis lce spyang gdong ma lta bu dang*/ laḥlaṃ dang gri gug gnyis dang mkha' lding gdong ma gnyis las skyes pa'i sbrul 'ching 'dod ma dang de'i phyir 'dod ma gnyis mkha' lding gdong ma lta bu rnams spros te g.yon nas bden bral gyi bar du rim pa bzhin 'khod/ ces brjod cing don dran pas skabs don 'grub la/ rgas pa la spro zhing nus na skyed byed rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan ngag du brjod/ de yang g.yas kyi dang po gnyis dang g.yon gyi phyi ma gnyis dus re la skyed pas chog go / gsum pa ni/ de ltar rang nyid ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi bdag nyid du gsal ba'i thugs kha nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug rnam par snang mdzad las sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams rang gi snying khar zhugs pa chags pa chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas spros pa'i byang chub kyi sems des sems can de rnams la dbang bskur bas sems can thams cad zhal gsum pa dang zhal sna tshogs pa dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha dang lha mo thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar byur/ de'i rkyen gyis sems can de rnams kyi rang rang gi lus kyi phung po lnga ni k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣu k+ṣl̥̄ las gshegs pa lnga/

khams lnga ni k+ṣā k+ṣī k+ṣṝ k+ṣū k+ṣl̥̄ las gshegs ma lnga/ dbang po drug ni k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣa k+ṣar k+ṣo k+ṣal k+ṣaṃ las sems dpa' drug yul drug ni k+ṣū k+ṣai k+ṣūr k+ṣau k+ṣal k+ṣaḥlas sems ma drug las dbang lnga ni k+ṣū k+ṣā k+ṣ+la k+ṣ+la las khro bo lnga/ bya ba lnga ni las khro mo lnga ste lha so gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyang skyes bu chen po'i mtshan so gnyis su gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /spro na sems can thams cad rang gi snying khar bcug nas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba lha mo'i pad+mar sa bon re re nas lhar rdzogs par bskyed de spro'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ oṃ su bi shud dha dharma dha tu swa bha wa ād+ma ko haṃ/ zhes rjod de chos dbyings shin du rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid nga'o snyam du brgyal bzung ngo*| |de rnams ni rnam pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ / gnyis pa las rgyal mchog la zhu ba klus bskul te bzhengs pa dang*/ de'i mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro ba dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa/ rnam dag sgom pa dang drug go /

dang po ni/ rang gi dpral bar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje āḥ thugs khar thugs rdo rje hūm̐/ gtsug tor dang lte ba'i a wa dhū tī'i nang du ho yig 'od zer dang bcas par gyur ho yig gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i chags pa chen po'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa shes rab ma'i lha mo dgu mtshan ma dang bcas pa rnams ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin du zhu bar gyur| de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhis snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu 'thun gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis| |dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis| |dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bur gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis| |dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor ba yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis| |dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /ces so so nas bskul zhing*| |thams cad kyis thun mong du/ stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas| |sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba gdon pa'i bsam pa yis/ /'gro ba'i mgon po spro bar mdzod/ /ces bskul bas bcom ldan 'das de stong pa nyid las bzhengs nas 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs te zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le las byung ba'i hūm̐ yig sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba las skyes pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba ces pa nas mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can ces brjod de gdong dman par byed bzhin pa'o/

/de dang dus mnyam du phreṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog ces pa nas snyom par 'jug bzhin pas gnas pa/ de bzhin du sku mdog phyag mtshan sngar bzhin du brjod nas shar gyi 'dab ma la a dang sbos snod las skyes pa'i nag mo 'bar ma dang*/ de bzhin du aḥdang mar me las skyes pa'i dmar mo 'bar ma dang*/ aṃ dang lha bshos las skyes pa'i dkar mo 'bar ma dang*/ ā dang dung las skyes pa'i ser mo 'bar ma dang*/ ha dang rnga yab nag po las skyes pa'i du ba ma dang*/ haḥdang rnga yab dmar po las skyes pa'i smig sgyu ma dang*/ haṃ dang rnga yab dkar po las skyes pa'i mkha' snang ma dang*/ hā dang rnga yab ser po las skyes pa'i mar me ma ser mo ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyis rnga yab ser po brgyad g.yob pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ ces pa nas mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa ces pa'i bar dang*/ zur bzhi'i dbang ldan du oṃ las chos kyi dung dkar po/ de bzhin du sngar bzhin rjod nas/ āḥlas gaṇ+ḍi/ huṃ las nor bu| ho las dpag bsam gyi shing ser po'o/ /nus ma dang mtshan ma 'di rnams ni yum gyi cha shas yin pas mngal nas spro ba sogs mi dgos so/ / gnyis pa ni/ rang gtso bo yab yum snyom par zhugs pas dkyil 'khor lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar bzhugs pa phung khams skye mched las sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pa chags pa chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le rnams las lha so so'i sa bon gyi yi ge dang de las so so'i phyag mtshan dang*/ de las so so'i sku rdzogs par gyur te pad+ma nas spros pa rang rang gi gnas su 'khod pa ni/ aṃ ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i mi bskyod pa dang ces pa nas bden bral gyi bar du rim pa bzhin du 'khod/

ces 'dod phyir 'dod kyi bar du rdzogs par brjod cing bsam mo/ / gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying khar hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs 'od zer sngon po 'jigs pa'i sku can ces pa nas/ oṃ bigh+nān krita hi/ bgegs mthar byed kyis dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam du byas pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ nus ma mtshan ma dang bcas pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ gshegs pa gshegs ma dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ sems dpa' sems ma dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam| khro bo khro mo dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ rnal 'byor ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis yab brgyad dang bcas pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ tshes lha sum brgya drug bcu dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ sku 'khor gyi sgo skyong steng 'og gi khro bo khro mo dang bcas pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ klu bcu yum dang bcas pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ rab gtum ma bcu yab dang bcas pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ gza' bcu las sogs pa khor yug gi lha rnams dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis gzungs ma dang bcas pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ 'dod ma so drug dam tshig pa la ye shes ba ro mnyam/ phyir 'dod ma so drug dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ gzhal yas khang dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zla nyi dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam du gyur to/ / bzhi pa ni/ rang gi dpral bar āḥ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma g.yon gsum ral gri dril bu nor bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ma dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros/ sku rdo rjes gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas slar log ste bdag nyid kyi mdun du 'khod/

oṃ badz+ra gan+he mā me sogs lha mo bcu gnyis rjod/ sku rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la dbang bkur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas sku'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis oṃ ā ī ṝ ū lī pañtsa dha tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i bum pa pa dbang bskur zhing dkrus pas sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams rang gi dpral bar zla ba la thim/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas| |sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin brlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod| |phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin brlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod| |lus sku rdo rje dang ro mnyam du gyur/ mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon gsum nor bu dril bu ral gri 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ces pa nas/ ngag gsung rdo rje dang ro mnyam du gyur/ ces pa'i bar sku dang gsung brje ba ma gtogs snga ma kho na ltar brjod/ 'on kyang gsung rdo rje'i lha rnams mgrin par nyi ma la thim/ zhes rjod do/ /snying khar thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur ba las/ thugs rdo rje nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma g.yon gsum dril bu ral gri nor bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i shes rab ma ces sogs sku dang thugs brjes nas sngar bzhin brjod la thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams snying khar sgra gcan la thim/ zhes dang sku yi gnas su thugs kyi zhes pa bcug pa'i tshigs bcad brjod la yid thugs rdo rje dang ro mnyam du gyur/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa ād+ma ko haṃ/ zhes rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /de ni khu ba'i chos las thabs rigs gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o| |rdul dang khu ba gnyis ka'i chos las shes rab rigs drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yum gyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje| mgrin par nyi ma'i steng du āḥdang pad+ma las gsung rdo rje/ snying khar sgra gcan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las thugs rdo rje rnams rang 'dra'i shes rab mdang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros/ rdo rje gsum gyis gdul bar bya ba'i ces pa nas 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe sogs brjod/ rdo rje gsum bdag la nas/ gsol ba btab pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha mo rnams kyis oṃ ā ī nas bkrus pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha rnams yum gyi gnas gsum du thim/ dpal ldan rdo rje gsum 'dzin pa/ rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje gsum 'dzin can gyis ni| |byin brlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sogs nas mdzod/ /yum gyi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang ro mnyam du gyur/ khyad par du yum gyi lte bar ho/ /gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā/ lnga pa ni/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa nas dbang bcu gcig gi gsol gdab dang bkur tshul bsrung 'khor ji bzhin byas la/ dbang bcu gcig gis dbang bkur bas dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyis rgyas btab pa ni/mi bskyod pa la rdor sems sngon po dang rdor sems la mi bskyod pa ljang khus phan tshun du rgyas btab cing*/ don grub la rin 'byung*/ rin 'byung la 'od dpag med/ 'od dpag med la rnam snang*| rnam snang la mi bskyod pa ste rgyas gdab bya drug ral pa'i cod pan can la rgyas 'debs byed drug po gtsug gtor dang chos gos 'dzin pa sa gnon las sogs pa'i phyag rgya can/

lha dang lha mo lhag ma rnams ni rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan 'dzin pas gnas pa'i ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa/ sngon po rnams la rdor sems/ nag po rnams la don grub dmar po rnams la rin 'byung*/ dkar po rnams la 'od dpag med/ ser po rnams la rnam snang gis rgyas btab par gyur/ gtsug gtor du thig le la a las mi bskyod pa/ snying khar sgra gcan la i las don grub/ dpral bar zla ba u las snang mtha'/ lte bar dus me la l̥ las rnam snang*/ mgrin par nyi ma la ṛ las rin 'byung*/ gsang bar ye shes la aṃ las rdor sems ces pa sku'i rgyas btab/ lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la l̥/ snying khar chu'i dkyil 'khor la u/ mgrin par me'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ/ dpral bar rlung gi dkyil 'khor la i/ gtsug gtor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la a ces pa gsung gi rgyas btab/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma la ā/ snying khar sgra gcan la huṃ/ lte bar dus me la ho ces pa thugs kyis rgyas btab/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor aṃ ye shes kyi rgyas gdab/ de ltar sku gsung thugs ye shes kyis rgyas btab pas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du gyur to/ / drug pa ni/ bum pa rnams dang du ba las sogs brgyad po rnams kyis snying khar chos kyi 'khor lor rab tu 'gyur/ rig ma rnams dang sangs rgyas nyid kyis mgo bor rtsibs bcu drug pa lhan cig skyes par rab tu grags/ /byang chub sems dpa' las sogs nyis 'gyur mi bdag rnams kyis mgrin par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lor 'gyur/ 'jigs ma las sogs nor ni gdengs can dag gis bsgyur ba rnams kyis lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'gyur// lag pa rkang pa'i tshigs la lha rnams kyis ni las kyi 'khor lo dgu bcu dus kyis bsnun pa ste/ klu dang gtum mo mi yi bdag po rnams kyis sor mo'i tshigs kyi mtshams la bya ba zhes byar 'gyur/

dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi bdag lo dang zla ba las sogs dbye bas so/ /thugs kyi rnam pa nyi ma ma yin nyin zhag so so'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni rnam par dag /rlung gi dag pas du ba las sogs rang gi snying kha'i pad+mar rtsa yi 'khor lo la gnas rnams| |nyon mongs rnams kyis drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyis 'dud/ /dung dang gaṇ+ḍi maṇi ljon pa zhes pa dag kyang de bzhin sku yi rdo rje las sogs kyis/ /bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis te rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub sems sogs kyis/ /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gci ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas/ khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams kyis/ /tsa muṇ+ḍa sogs thun brgyad kyis te pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod kyis/ /lha min las sogs nyi ma'i zla bas pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs kyis so/ /gsang bar mi bdag nyis 'gyur chu tshod rnams kyis klu rnams dang ni gtum mo rnams kyang rnam par dag /de bzhin 'dod ma las sogs de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya bas rnam par dag /skra rnams kyis ni grub pa mtha' dag ba spu rnams kyis dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs/ /de nyid rnams kyis gtso bo'i mtshon cha rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khams kyis phyi yi phyag rgya'o| |rdo rjes nang gi phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du yang dag gnas pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang sna tshogs yum ni rnam gsum srid gnas 'gyur med ye shes dbye ba las/

/dpal ldan dag pa las ni chos skur 'gyur te chos las nges par longs spyod rdzogs sku bzang pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs las sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag ngo'i sems can kun don byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa'i gnas skabs shin du gnyid log nges par slar yang gzhan dang lus kyi dbye bas sad pa ste/ /de ltar lus kyi rab tu dbye bas srog chags rnams kyi lus pa yid ni rnam pa bzhi ru gnas/ /sprul par yid ni longs spyod byed pa po ru rab tu 'gyur te lus dang ngag gi dbang pos so/ /longs spyod rdzogs la ma mthong sems par 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis chos kyi sku la gnyid kyang ngo*/ /dag pa las ni bde bar rab 'gyur 'dir ni nyin mtshan dus su thig le grol ba gsum gyi mthar/ /de phyir de ni nyin mtshan dus su rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya ste 'gyur med don du'o/ /g.yon du srog ni rab tu rgyu bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du ni g.yas pa kum pa gang yin pa/ /de ni g.yon brkyang stabs te mnyam pa'i stabs dang gzhan pa g.yas brkyang me dang nyi ma'i rgyu ba las/ /sa ga dang ni zlum po nyid dang mchog gi rol pa'i stabs dang pad+ma dang ni rdo rje'i gdan/ /nam mkha' sogs la rab tu rgyu ba mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod pa dag la srog rlung rnam pa lnga/

/zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod do// de ltar las rgyal mchog ni rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag go / gsum pa ni/ rang dang shes rab gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar ho/ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las āḥ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa huṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de la dmigs pas bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa āḥlas skyes pa'i pad+mas mtshan pa| oṃ nāṃ bhau na maḥsogs drug sngar bzhin phyag rgya dang bcas te brjod/ yum gyi mgo bor ū/ snying khar ī/ gtsug tor du ā/ lte bar l̥̄/ mgrin par rāṃ| gsang bar i/ hūm̐ rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal gyis yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi rtse mo na bzhugs pa'i ho yig ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i klog dang mtshungs pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas lte ba'i g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor phung po lnga dang g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor khams lnga dang mig sogs dbang po drug dang gzugs sogs yul drug gi rlung thams cad bsregs pas rlung rgyu ba med cing dbang po yul la 'jug pa med par byas nas/ gtum mo'i me de a ba dhū tī na song ba spyi bo'i haṃ yig ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzugs can reg ma thag du taṃ yig zhu ba thig le'i gzugs kyis dpral ba nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying kha nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad dga'| lte ba nas gsang bar sleb pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba khyad par can zla ba'i cha bco lnga yongs su gang ba'i tshul du byon par gyur/ de ni thig le'i rnal 'byor te sgrub pa'i yan lag go / bzhi pa ni/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de shes rab kyi chos 'byung gi ming can rang gi a ba dhū tī'i gsang ba'i sna rtser yungs 'bru tsam gyi sku'i thig ler gyur pa de nyid ji ltar byon pa de bzhin du slar yang steng du gshegs pa lte ba'i dbus su rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu'i tshul gyis byon nas gsung gi thig ler gyur pas dga' ba/

snying kha'i dbus su rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i tshul gyis byon nas| thugs kyi thig ler gyur pas mchog dga'/ mgrin pa'i dbus su skyes bu byed 'bras kyi tshul gyis byon nas ye shes kyi thig ler gyur pas khyad dga'/ dpral ba'i dbus su bral 'bras kyi tshul gyis byon nas dri ma med pa'i thig le sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan zhing*/ pra phab pa'i me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur pas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong zhing*/ thig le de yis dngas shing gsal ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lor spros pas khams gsum po thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi thig le bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyangs nas 'pho ba med pa'i bde ba'i 'od zer gyis srid pa gsum gyi dus gsum cig car du shes pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rang rgyud la skyes par gyur pa ni drang don bskyed rims kyi phra mo'i rnal 'byor te sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /nges don rdzogs rims kyi rnal 'byor ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ zhes brjes chags kyi nga rgyal dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra sa twa a haṃ dur dan+ta da ma ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces pa 'dod lha'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ gsum pa la sngags bzlas shing mchod bstod bya ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol ba/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba gzhan bsgrub pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ lha gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs khar zla ba'i gdan la rang rang gi sa bon gyi mtha' mar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas sngags dang lhan cig 'jug pa'i rlung gis snying kha'i sa bon la 'jug pa'i mdzad pa can du gyur par bsams la/ phreng ba byin gyis brlab te/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hraḥphaṭa/ phreng ba stong par gyur pa'i ngang las phreng rdog rnams huṃ las rdo rje 'dzin par gyur/

rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis huṃ dang mtshan dpe'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dbyangs gsal rnams spyan drangs te phreng rdog rnams la thim par gyur/ spro na mchod phreng nas bshad pa bzhin byin gyis brlab cing*/ der bshad pa ltar sngags kyi dgra grogs la mkhas par bya ba dang*| bzlas bya'i sngags kyi rnam gzhag dang bza' tshul rnams kyang de bzhin du byas la/ 'dir nye bar 'kho ba/ oṃ āḥ huṃ ho haṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa snying po dang*| oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hṝ hrāḥswā hā/ ces pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ phraiṃ bi shwa mā tā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa yum gyi snying po rnams bzla zhing sngags gzhan rnams mchod phreng nas bshad bzhin bya'o/ /de nas chu bzhi dang lha ma bcu gnyis kyi sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ dus zhabs pa ltar na mchod pa bcu dang bdud rtsis mchod pa ni na maḥ'i mchod pa ste skabs 'dir byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /ces sogs 'dud nyi shus bstod cing*/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med ces sogs mchod phreng nas bshad pa'i bstod pa rnams kyis kyang bstod do/ / gnyis pa ni/ rang gi gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar bde chen 'khor lo'i gtso bo yum dang*/ snying khar rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar nus ma mtshan ma dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa'i lte bar gshegs pa gshegs ma rnams dang mgrin par rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar sems dpa' sems ma thugs kyi sgo skyong dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lte bar rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa'i lte bar gsung gi rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ gsang bar rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar sku'i sgo skyong rnams dang*/ las kyi 'khor lo rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/

bya ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje rtse mo bdun pa nyi shu'i lte bar klu dang rab gtum ma rnams gshegs pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur/ gsum pa la mdun bskyed mchod cing*/ gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ji ltar bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor gzhan rnams la ji ltar slob tshul lo| | dang po ni/ mdun du ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byas te tsan+dan las sogs pa dri bzang po byugs la/ chang sngar gtor ma byin brlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ chos 'byung gru gsum byas nas de'i dbus su zlum por bskor la/ ngag tu maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su skad cig gis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang zhing gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa'i thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor gsal la rdzogs par gyur zhes brjod cing bsams la| oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ khams gsum dbang phyug ni/ ces sogs chu bzhi lha mo bcu gnyis tshigs bcad dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod lan gsum dkrugs la dbus nas blangs te/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan la bzhi pa'i rnam dbye byin pa la mgor oṃ dang mthar na maḥ sbyar nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la mchod 'phreng ltar dbul/ de nas/ oṃ bud dhā ya na maḥ oṃ dharmā ya na maḥ oṃ saṃ ghā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra sa twa ya na maḥ de bzhin du/ oṃ pradz+nya pā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ swa bhā wi ka kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ dharma kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ saṃ bho ka kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ nīrmā ṇa kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ dz+nyā na badz+rā ya na maḥ oṃ tsit+ta badz+rā ya na maḥ oṃ wāka badz+ra ya na maḥ oṃ kā ya badz+ra ya na maḥ oṃ tsa tur bi mok+ṣe bh+yo na maḥ oṃ tsa tur brah+ma bi hā re bh+yo na maḥ oṃ sap+ta triṃ shad bo dhi pak+ṣi kadha rme bh+yo na maḥ oṃ tsa tur shī ti sa hasra dharma kan+dhe bh+yo na maḥ oṃ sarba dharma de sha ke bh+yo na maḥ

oṃ rad na tra yā ya na maḥ oṃ shākya mu ne ye na maḥ oṃ kā la tsakra ya na maḥ oṃ dā na pā ra mi tā ye na maḥ oṃ shī la pā ri mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ k+ṣā n+ti pa ra mi hā yai na maḥ oṃ bīr+ya pā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ dh+yan pā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ u pā ya pā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ praṇi dhā na sbar mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ bā la bā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ dz+nyā na pā ra mi tā yai na maḥ oṃ dza ya gha ṭai bh+yo na maḥ oṃ bi dza ya gha ṭe bh+yo na maḥ oṃ sarba tsit+na bh+yo na maḥ oṃ sarba mu te bh+yo na maḥ oṃ tsin+ta ma na yai na maḥ oṃ dharma gaṇ+ḍai na maḥ oṃ dharma shaṃ khā ya na maḥ oṃ kalpa brik+ṣā ya na maḥ oṃ a k+ṣo bh+yā ya na maḥ oṃ a mo gha sid dha ye na maḥ oṃ rat+na saṃ bha wā ya na maḥ oṃ a mi tā bhā ya na maḥ oṃ be ro tsa nā ya na maḥ oṃ lo tsa nā yai na maḥ oṃ mā ma kyai namaḥ oṃ paṇ+ḍa rā ye na maḥ oṃ tā rā yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa r+yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇa ye na maḥ oṃ kha garba ya na maḥ oṃ k+ṣi ti gar+bhā ya na maḥ oṃ lo ke shwa rā ya na maḥ oṃ sarba ṇi wa ra ṇa pi skaṃ bi na ye na maḥ oṃ sa man+ta bhā drā ya na maḥ oṃ gan+dha badz+ra yai na maḥ oṃ rū pa badz+rā yai na maḥ oṃ ra sa badz+rā yai na maḥ oṃ spar+sha badz+rā yai na maḥ oṃ shap+ta badz+rā yai na maḥ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+rā yai na maḥ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣā ya na maḥ oṃ bigh+rān+ta kā ya na maḥ oṃ pradz+nyān+ta kā ya na maḥ oṃ pad+man+ta kā ya na maḥ oṃ ya mān+ta kā ya na maḥ oṃ stam+bhi n+yai na maḥ oṃ mī ni n+yai na maḥ.oṃ sto bhi n+yai na maḥ oṃ a ti bī r+yā yai na maḥ oṃ a ti nī lā+e yai na maḥ oṃ sarba dhā ri ṇī bh+yo na maḥ oṃ ṣa ṭa aṅgā ya na maḥ ces pa thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsartsi kā yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra wā ra h+yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra ma he shwa r+yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra i na maḥ oṃ badz+ra brah+ma ṇ+yai na maḥ

oṃ badz+ra ma hā la na maḥ oṃ badz+ra kau ma r+yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra baiṣ+ṇa byai na maḥ oṃ aṣ+ta aṣ+ta ke na tsatuḥ ṣaṣ+ṭhi badz+ra yo gi nī bh+yo na maḥ oṃ ṣa ṭa triṃ sha ta its+tshā bh+yo na maḥ ces pa gsung gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra baiṣ+ṇa be na maḥ oṃ badz+ra nai ri t+yā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra ag+na ye na maḥ oṃ badz+ra u dūdha ye na maḥ oṃ badz+ra in+d+ra ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra ī shwarā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra brat+ma ṇe na maḥ oṃ badz+ra binā ya kā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra karti she yā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra wā ya be na maḥ oṃ badz+ra ya mā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣe bh+yo na maḥ oṃ wā ru ṇ+yai na maḥ oṃ wā ya byai na maḥ oṃ ya mi n+yai na maḥ eṃ yā k+ṣi ṇ+ye na maḥ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya na maḥ oṃ a tsa lnga ya na maḥ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dzā ya na maḥ oṃ nī la daṇ+ḍa ya na maḥ oṃ suṃ bha rā ja ya na maḥ oṃ rau tra ak+ṣ+yai na maḥ oṃ badz+ra shri khaṃ lā ye na ma ཿ oṃ tsun+dā yai na maḥ oṃ bhṛ ku ṭ+yai na maḥ oṃ mā rī ts+yai na maḥ oṃ pra t+ye ka mā sa bhe nga na ṣaṣ+ṭhi ut+tar triṃ shata badz+ra ti thi de wī bh+yo na maḥ oṃ ṣaṭa triṃ sha ta pra tī ts+tsha bh+yo na maḥ oṃ badz+ra dza yā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra karko ṭa kā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra wā su ka ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra a nan ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra tak+ṣa kā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā pad+ma ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra ku li kā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ kha pā lā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra bi dza yā ya na maḥ ces pa sku'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa'o/ /oṃ shwā nā s+ya yai na maḥ oṃ sū ka rā s+ya yai na maḥ oṃ byagha s+yā yai na maḥ oṃ dzam+bu kā s+yā yai na maḥ oṃ ga ru ḍā s+yā yai na maḥ oṃ u lū kā s+ya yai na maḥ oṃ gṛḍhā s+yā yai na maḥ oṃ kā kā s+yā yai na maḥ oṃ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥ ces pa ni dur khrod brgyad po rnams la'o/ /phyi rol du 'jig rten par snang ba'i lha rnams la/ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra sū r+yā ya na maḥ
